## C1 отключает commit для старых тестов. Явный --campaign-op даёт им только снимок боя.
func _read_mission() -> bool:
	mission_config = Campaign.pending()
	_bench_t += delta
	# перебираем типы смерти, чтобы на скриншоте были все
	if not _gore_stress and not _kinds:
		horde.death_override = int(_bench_t / 1.5) % Gore.Death.size()
	if _bench_t < BENCH_WARMUP:
		return
	_bench_frames += 1
	_bench_frame_ms += delta * 1000.0
	_bench_worst_ms = maxf(_bench_worst_ms, delta * 1000.0)
	_bench_horde_ms += horde.update_ms
	_bench_physics_ms += Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS) * 1000.0
	_bench_hud_ms += $HUD/Hud.draw_ms
	_bench_enemies += horde.count
	if _bench_t < BENCH_WARMUP + BENCH_DURATION:
		return
	_bench = false
	var n := float(_bench_frames)
	var label := "KINDS" if _kinds else "BENCH"
	print("%s frames=%d avg_fps=%.1f avg_frame_ms=%.2f worst_frame_ms=%.2f horde_ms=%.2f enemies=%.0f kills=%d" % [
		label, _bench_frames, 1000.0 / (_bench_frame_ms / n), _bench_frame_ms / n, _bench_worst_ms,
		_bench_horde_ms / n, _bench_enemies / n, kills])
	print("%s process_ms=%.2f physics_ms=%.2f draw_calls=%d objects=%d gore=%d particles=%d wet=%d" % [
		label, Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0, Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS) * 1000.0,
		Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME), Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_COUNT),
		gore.count, effects.particle_count(), floor_decals.pool_count()])
	print("%s physics_avg_ms=%.2f hud_ms=%.3f" % [label, _bench_physics_ms / n, _bench_hud_ms / n])
	if _shot_path != "":
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png(_shot_path)
		print(label, " screenshot: ", _shot_path)
	get_tree().quit()


## Управление задаём кодом по физическим клавишам — работает при любой раскладке.
static func _setup_input() -> void:
	_add_action("move_left", [_key(KEY_A), _key(KEY_LEFT), _axis(JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X, -1.0)])
	_add_action("move_right", [_key(KEY_D), _key(KEY_RIGHT), _axis(JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X, 1.0)])
	_add_action("move_up", [_key(KEY_W), _key(KEY_UP), _axis(JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y, -1.0)])
	_add_action("move_down", [_key(KEY_S), _key(KEY_DOWN), _axis(JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y, 1.0)])
	_add_action("dash", [_key(KEY_SPACE), _key(KEY_SHIFT), _button(JOY_BUTTON_A)])
	_add_action("reload", [_key(KEY_R), _button(JOY_BUTTON_X)])
	_add_action("grenade", [_key(KEY_G), _mouse(MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE), _button(JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER)])
	_add_action("aim_override", [_mouse(MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT)])
	_add_action("fire", [_mouse(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT), _axis(JOY_AXIS_TRIGGER_RIGHT, 1.0)])
	_add_action("aim_left", [_axis(JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X, -1.0)])
	_add_action("aim_right", [_axis(JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X, 1.0)])
	_add_action("aim_up", [_axis(JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_Y, -1.0)])
	_add_action("aim_down", [_axis(JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_Y, 1.0)])


static func _add_action(action: StringName, events: Array) -> void:
	if InputMap.has_action(action):
		return
	InputMap.add_action(action, 0.25)
	for e in events:
		InputMap.action_add_event(action, e)


static func _key(code: Key) -> InputEventKey:
	var e := InputEventKey.new()
	e.physical_keycode = code
	return e


static func _mouse(button: MouseButton) -> InputEventMouseButton:
	var e := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	e.button_index = button
	return e


static func _axis(axis: JoyAxis, value: float) -> InputEventJoypadMotion:
	var e := InputEventJoypadMotion.new()
	e.axis = axis
	e.axis_value = value
	return e


static func _button(button: JoyButton) -> InputEventJoypadButton:
	var e := InputEventJoypadButton.new()
	e.button_index = button
	return e


## --aim-test: настоящий маршрут ввода и выстрела, сохранение только в tmp/.
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if player == null:
		return
	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	_frame += 1
	_time += delta
	_run_shatter()
	_compact()
	_move(delta)
	_rebuild_grid()
	_separate()
	_render()
	queue_redraw()
	update_ms = (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0


## Раскол замёрзших: осколки ранят соседей в радиусе 24; убитые замёрзшие добавляют свои точки в очередь.
func _run_shatter() -> void:
	var n := mini(_shatter_queue.size(), SHATTER_PER_TICK)
	if n == 0:
		return
	var batch := _shatter_queue.slice(0, n)
	_shatter_queue = _shatter_queue.slice(n)
	for p in batch:
		for j in query_radius(p, 24.0):
			chill_hit(j, 0.3, 3, true)
			damage(j, 5.0, (pos[j] - p).normalized(), 40.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.CRYO)


func _move(delta: float) -> void:
	var ppos := player.global_position
	var decay := exp(-10.0 * delta)
	var touch_damage := 0.0
	var damage_scale := 1.0 + damage_growth_per_min * minutes
	for i in count:
		if dead[i] == 1:
			continue
		touch_cd[i] = maxf(touch_cd[i] - delta, 0.0)
		var frozen := freeze_t[i] > 0.0
		var p := pos[i]
		var old := p
		var to := ppos - p
		var d := to.length()
		if d > far_distance:
			# отставших возвращаем в кольцо, чтобы орда не терялась позади
			p = spawn_point(ppos)
			old = p
			to = ppos - p
			d = to.length()
		var dir := to / d if d > 0.001 else Vector2.ZERO
		var k := knock[i]
		var spd := speed[i] * (1.0 - chill[i])
		if freeze_t[i] > 0.0:
			freeze_t[i] -= delta
			spd = 0.0
			k *= 0.2
		chill[i] = maxf(chill[i] - 0.3 * delta, 0.0)
		if burn_t[i] > 0.0:
			burn_t[i] -= delta
			if dead[i] == 0:
				damage(i, burn_dps[i] * delta, Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.INCENDIARY)
		if dead[i] == 1: # огонь мог убить в этом кадре
			continue
		var move_dir := dir
		if kind[i] == Kind.SPITTER:
			spit_cd[i] = maxf(spit_cd[i] - delta, 0.0)
			move_dir = -dir if d < 130.0 else (dir if d > 170.0 else Vector2.ZERO)
			if not frozen:
				if spit_windup[i] > 0.0:
					spit_windup[i] = maxf(spit_windup[i] - delta, 0.0)
					move_dir = Vector2.ZERO
					if spit_windup[i] == 0.0:
						if d >= 90.0 and d <= 260.0:
							spit_fired.emit(p, ppos, 10.0 * damage_scale * (ELITE_DAMAGE if elite[i] == 1 else 1.0))
				elif spit_cd[i] <= 0.0 and d >= 90.0 and d <= 260.0:
					spit_windup[i] = SPIT_WINDUP
					spit_cd[i] = SPIT_COOLDOWN
					move_dir = Vector2.ZERO
		p += move_dir * spd * delta + k * delta
		knock[i] = k * decay
		# игрок «тяжёлый»: выталкивает зомби из себя
		var away := p - ppos
		var ad2 := away.length_squared()
		var touch_r := Player.RADIUS + radius[i]
		if ad2 < (touch_r + 1.0) * (touch_r + 1.0):
			if touch_cd[i] <= 0.0 and not frozen:
				var hit_damage: float = KINDS[kind[i]]["damage"] * damage_scale * (ELITE_DAMAGE if elite[i] == 1 else 1.0)
				touch_damage = maxf(touch_damage, hit_damage)
				touch_cd[i] = TOUCH_COOLDOWN
			if ad2 > 0.0001 and ad2 < touch_r * touch_r:
				p = ppos + away / sqrt(ad2) * touch_r
		p = p.clamp(arena.position + Vector2.ONE * radius[i], arena.end - Vector2.ONE * radius[i])
		pos[i] = p
		var a := dir.angle() if freeze_t[i] <= 0.0 else angle[i]
		if stage[i] == 3 and freeze_t[i] <= 0.0:
			a += sin(_time * 7.0 + seed_value[i] * 20.0) * 0.35 # еле живые шатаются
		angle[i] = a
		flash[i] = maxf(flash[i] - delta * 10.0, 0.0)
		# следы и капли: функцию зовём только когда что-то нужно (раньше — 500 вызовов за тик впустую)
		if floor_decals != null:
			var sa := step_acc[i] + p.distance_to(old)
			if sa >= STEP_LENGTH or stage[i] > 0 or (i + _frame) & 3 == 0:
				step_acc[i] = sa
				_feet_and_drips(i, p, a)
			else:
				step_acc[i] = sa
	if touch_damage > 0.0:
		player_touched.emit(touch_damage)


## Кровавые следы, если зомби прошёл по луже, и капли с раненых.
func _feet_and_drips(i: int, p: Vector2, a: float) -> void:
	if (i + _frame) & 3 == 0 and floor_decals.is_wet(p):
		feet[i] = BLOODY_STEPS
	if step_acc[i] >= STEP_LENGTH:
		step_acc[i] = 0.0
		if feet[i] > 0:
			var side := 1.5 if feet[i] % 2 == 0 else -1.5
			floor_decals.stamp_print(p + Vector2.from_angle(a + PI * 0.5) * side, a, feet[i] / float(BLOODY_STEPS))
			feet[i] -= 1
	var st := stage[i]
	if st > 0 and randf() < 0.012 * st:
		floor_decals.stamp_dot(p + Vector2(randf_range(-3, 3), randf_range(-3, 3)), 1.0, Color(0.38, 0.03, 0.03, 0.85))


func _rebuild_grid() -> void:
	_head.fill(-1)
	for i in count:
		var p := pos[i]
		var c := clampi(int(p.x / CELL), 0, _grid_w - 1) + 1 + (clampi(int(p.y / CELL), 0, _grid_h - 1) + 1) * _stride
		_next[i] = _head[c]
		_head[c] = i


func _separate() -> void:
	# Каждая пара обходится один раз: хвост своей ячейки + четыре «передние» соседки (E, SW, S, SE).
	# Раньше обходили все 9 ячеек с проверкой j > i и границ — вдвое больше проходов по спискам.
	var gw := _grid_w - 1
	var gh := _grid_h - 1
	var stride := _stride
	for i in count:
		if dead[i] == 1:
			continue
		var p := pos[i]
		var ri := radius[i]
		var base := clampi(int(p.x / CELL), 0, gw) + 1 + (clampi(int(p.y / CELL), 0, gh) + 1) * stride
		var j := _next[i]
		var k := 0
		while true:
			while j != -1:
				if dead[j] == 0:
					var q := pos[j]
					var dv := p - q
					var d2 := dv.length_squared()
					var min_d := ri + radius[j]
					if d2 < min_d * min_d:
						if d2 < 0.0001:
							dv = Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * 0.1
							d2 = 0.01
						var d := sqrt(d2)
						var push := dv * ((min_d - d) / d * 0.5)
						p += push
						pos[j] = q - push
				j = _next[j]
			if k == 4:
				break
			j = _head[base + _noff[k]]
			k += 1
		pos[i] = p


## Убираем мёртвых: последний живой переезжает на место убитого.
func _compact() -> void:
	var i := 0
	while i < count:
		if dead[i] == 1:
			count -= 1
			if i != count:
				pos[i] = pos[count]
				knock[i] = knock[count]
				hp[i] = hp[count]
				max_hp[i] = max_hp[count]
				speed[i] = speed[count]
				angle[i] = angle[count]
				flash[i] = flash[count]
				dead[i] = dead[count]
				kind[i] = kind[count]
				elite[i] = elite[count]
				radius[i] = radius[count]
				touch_cd[i] = touch_cd[count]
				spit_cd[i] = spit_cd[count]
				spit_windup[i] = spit_windup[count]
				variant[i] = variant[count]
				stage[i] = stage[count]
				wounds[i] = wounds[count]
				holes[i] = holes[count]
				seed_value[i] = seed_value[count]
				feet[i] = feet[count]
				step_acc[i] = step_acc[count]
				uid[i] = uid[count]
				burn_t[i] = burn_t[count]
				burn_dps[i] = burn_dps[count]
				burn_spread[i] = burn_spread[count]
				burn_r[i] = burn_r[count]
				chill[i] = chill[count]
				chill_hits[i] = chill_hits[count]
				freeze_t[i] = freeze_t[count]
				shatter[i] = shatter[count]
			dead[count] = 0
		else:
			i += 1


func _render() -> void:
	var front := 0
	var back := count - 1
	for i in count:
		# Элитки поверх обычной толпы: обводку не перекрывают поздние спавны.
		var slot := front
		if elite[i] == 1:
			slot = back
			back -= 1
		else:
			front += 1
		var o := slot * FLOATS_PER_INSTANCE

var _charges_left := 0
var _charge_target := Vector2.ZERO
var _charge_from := Vector2.ZERO
var _charge_hit := false
var _telegraph_time := 1.0
var _recover_time := 0.6
var _slam_pos := Vector2.ZERO
var _slam_hit := false
var _slam_wave := false
var _wave_previous := 0.0
var _sheet: Texture2D
var _flash_material: ShaderMaterial
var _body: Node2D


func _ready() -> void:
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://art/boss.png"):
		_sheet = PixelArt.tex("boss")
	# Один слой тела отделяет белую вспышку от телеграфов и тени.
	var shader := Shader.new()
	shader.code = "shader_type canvas_item; uniform float hit = 0.0; void fragment() { COLOR.rgb = mix(COLOR.rgb, vec3(1.0), hit); }"
	_flash_material = ShaderMaterial.new()
	_flash_material.shader = shader
	_body = Node2D.new()
	_body.material = _flash_material
	_body.draw.connect(_draw_sprite)
	add_child(_body)
	visible = _alive


## Параметры задаются до старта; телеграфы и урон атак не меняются.
func set_mission_profile(hp_mul: float, shed_fraction: float) -> void:
	max_hp = MAX_HP * clampf(hp_mul, 1.0, 1.25)
	armor_threshold = clampf(shed_fraction, 0.35, 0.5)


func start(p: Vector2) -> void:
	hp = max_hp
	phase = 1
	_alive = true
	_state = State.WALK
	_last_attack = -1
	_age = 0.0
	_time = 0.0
	_walk = 0.0
	_facing = Vector2.RIGHT
	_charge_cd = 0.0
	_slam_cd = 0.0
	_roar_cd = 0.0
	_contact_cd = 0.0
	_flash = 0.0
	_plate_damage = 0.0
	_blood_time = 0.0
	_charges_left = 0
	_charge_hit = false
	_slam_hit = false
	_slam_wave = false
	global_position = _bounded(p)
	visible = true
	queue_redraw()


func take_damage(amount: float, dir: Vector2, at: Vector2) -> bool:
	if not _alive or _state == State.SHED or amount <= 0.0:
		return false
	var damage := amount * (0.75 if phase == 1 else 1.0)
	hp = maxf(hp - damage, 0.0)
	_flash = 0.08
	if hp <= 0.0:
		_alive = false
		visible = false
		_charges_left = 0
		_slam_wave = false
		died.emit(global_position)
		return true
	if phase == 1:
		_plate_damage += damage
		while _plate_damage >= 1500.0:
			_plate_damage -= 1500.0
			armor_plate.emit(at, dir.normalized() if dir != Vector2.ZERO else _facing)
		if hp <= max_hp * armor_threshold:
			_shed_armor()
	elif effects:
		effects.blood_hit(at, dir, false)
	queue_redraw()
	return false


func hit_test(p: Vector2, r: float) -> bool:
	return _alive and p.distance_squared_to(global_position) <= pow(RADIUS + maxf(r, 0.0), 2.0)


func is_alive() -> bool:
	return _alive


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not _alive:
		return
	global_position = _bounded(global_position)
	_time += delta
	_age += delta
	_flash = maxf(_flash - delta, 0.0)
	_charge_cd = maxf(_charge_cd - delta, 0.0)
	_slam_cd = maxf(_slam_cd - delta, 0.0)
	_roar_cd = maxf(_roar_cd - delta, 0.0)
	_contact_cd = maxf(_contact_cd - delta, 0.0)
	if _state == State.SHED:
		if _age + 0.000001 >= SHED_TIME:
			_enter(State.WALK)
	elif player and not player.is_dead:
		match _state:
			State.WALK:
				_choose_attack()
				if _state == State.WALK:
					_move_to(global_position.move_toward(player.global_position, (40.0 if phase == 1 else 60.0) * delta))
					_contact()
			State.TELEGRAPH:
				if _age + 0.000001 >= _telegraph_time:
					_charge_hit = false
					_enter(State.CHARGE)
			State.CHARGE:
				_charge(delta)
			State.RECOVER:
				if _age + 0.000001 >= _recover_time:
					if _charges_left > 0:
						_begin_telegraph()
					else:
						_enter(State.WALK)
			State.SLAM:
				_slam()
			State.ROAR:
				if _age + 0.000001 >= ROAR_TIME:
					_roar_cd = ROAR_COOLDOWN
					_enter(State.WALK)
					roar.emit(15 if phase == 1 else 25)
	var moving := _state == State.WALK or _state == State.CHARGE
	if phase == 2 and moving and effects:
		_blood_time += delta
		if _blood_time >= 0.1:
			_blood_time = 0.0
			effects.emit(global_position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * 10.0, -_facing * 12.0, 0.3, Effects.BLOOD, 2.5, 5.0, true)
	queue_redraw()


func _choose_attack() -> void:
	var distance := global_position.distance_to(player.global_position)
	if distance > 180.0 and _charge_cd <= 0.0 and _last_attack != State.CHARGE:
		_begin_charge_series()
	elif distance < 120.0 and _slam_cd <= 0.0 and _last_attack != State.SLAM:
		_last_attack = State.SLAM
		_slam_pos = global_position
		_slam_hit = false
		_slam_wave = false
		_enter(State.SLAM)
	elif _roar_cd <= 0.0 and _last_attack != State.ROAR and _few_runners():
		_last_attack = State.ROAR
		_enter(State.ROAR)
		if effects:
			effects.blood_burst(global_position + _facing * 18.0, _facing, 18, 80.0, 0.8)
	elif _charge_cd <= 0.0 and _last_attack != State.CHARGE and distance > RADIUS + Player.RADIUS:
		# Дистанция задаёт приоритет, но не блокирует чередование при живых бегунах.
		_begin_charge_series()


func _begin_charge_series() -> void:
	_last_attack = State.CHARGE
	_charges_left = 1 if phase == 1 else 3
	_begin_telegraph()


func _few_runners() -> bool:
	if horde == null:
		return true
	var runners := 0
	for j in horde.query_radius(global_position, 260.0):
		if j >= 0 and j < horde.count and horde.dead[j] == 0 and horde.kind[j] == Horde.Kind.RUNNER:
			runners += 1
			if runners >= 8:
				return false
	return true


func _begin_telegraph() -> void:
	var offset := player.global_position - global_position
	if offset.length_squared() > 0.000001:
		_facing = offset.normalized()
	_charge_from = global_position
	# Луч до внутренней границы: вся туша остаётся в арене.
	var inner := _inner_arena()
	# Пролёт на CHARGE_OVERSHOOT за игрока, но не дальше края арены: босс не уезжает за экран.
	var distance := offset.length() + CHARGE_OVERSHOOT
	if absf(_facing.x) > 0.000001:
		var edge := inner.end.x if _facing.x > 0.0 else inner.position.x
		distance = minf(distance, maxf((edge - global_position.x) / _facing.x, 0.0))
	if absf(_facing.y) > 0.000001:
		var edge := inner.end.y if _facing.y > 0.0 else inner.position.y
		distance = minf(distance, maxf((edge - global_position.y) / _facing.y, 0.0))
	_charge_target = _bounded(global_position + _facing * distance)
	_telegraph_time = 1.0 if phase == 1 else 0.7
	_enter(State.TELEGRAPH)
	charge_telegraph.emit(_charge_from, _charge_target, _telegraph_time)


func _charge(delta: float) -> void:
	var from := global_position
	_move_to(from.move_toward(_charge_target, CHARGE_SPEED * delta))
	var to := global_position
	if not _charge_hit:
		var nearest := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(player.global_position, from, to)
		if nearest.distance_squared_to(player.global_position) <= pow(RADIUS + Player.RADIUS, 2.0):
			_charge_hit = true # один запрос урона на проход, даже при неуязвимости
			player.take_damage(35.0)
	if not _alive or _state != State.CHARGE:
		return
	if horde:
		var middle := (from + to) * 0.5
		for j in horde.query_radius(middle, from.distance_to(to) * 0.5 + RADIUS):
			if j < 0 or j >= horde.count or horde.dead[j] != 0:
				continue
			var p := horde.pos[j]
			var nearest := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(p, from, to)
			if nearest.distance_squared_to(p) <= pow(RADIUS + horde.radius[j], 2.0):
				if horde.damage(j, 9999.0, _facing, 300.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.STANDARD, false, horde.pos[j], true):
					crushed.emit(p, _facing)
				if not _alive or _state != State.CHARGE:
					return
	if to.distance_squared_to(_charge_target) < 0.000001 or to == from:
		_charges_left -= 1
		_recover_time = 0.4 if _charges_left > 0 else 0.6
		if _charges_left == 0:
			_charge_cd = CHARGE_COOLDOWN
		_enter(State.RECOVER)


func _slam() -> void:
	if _age + 0.000001 < SLAM_WINDUP:
		return
	if not _slam_wave:
		_slam_wave = true
		_slam_cd = SLAM_COOLDOWN * (0.7 if phase == 2 else 1.0)
		if camera:
			camera.shake(6.0)
		slam_started.emit(_slam_pos)
		if not _alive or _state != State.SLAM:
			return
	var radius := SLAM_RADIUS * clampf((_age - SLAM_WINDUP) / SLAM_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
	# Относительное движение игрока и фронта волны между двумя тиками.
	var relative := player.global_position.distance_to(_slam_pos) - radius
	if not _slam_hit:
		if absf(relative) <= SLAM_WIDTH * 0.5 + Player.RADIUS or _wave_previous * relative < 0.0:
			_slam_hit = true
			player.take_damage(25.0)
	_wave_previous = relative
	if _age + 0.000001 >= SLAM_WINDUP + SLAM_TIME:
		_slam_wave = false
		_enter(State.WALK)


func _contact() -> void:
	if _contact_cd <= 0.0 and global_position.distance_squared_to(player.global_position) <= pow(RADIUS + Player.RADIUS, 2.0):
		_contact_cd = 0.8
		player.take_damage(20.0 if phase == 1 else 25.0)


func _shed_armor() -> void:
	phase = 2
	_charges_left = 0
	_slam_wave = false
	_enter(State.SHED)
	if camera:
		camera.shake(9.0)
	if effects:
		effects.blood_burst(global_position, _facing, 100, 190.0, PI)
	for k in 8:
		var dir := Vector2.from_angle(float(k) * TAU / 8.0)
		armor_plate.emit(global_position + dir * 12.0, dir)
	phase_changed.emit(2)


func _enter(state: State) -> void:
	_state = state
	_age = 0.0
	if state == State.SLAM:
		_wave_previous = player.global_position.distance_to(global_position)


func _move_to(p: Vector2) -> void:
	var before := global_position
	global_position = _bounded(p)
	var step := global_position - before
	_walk += step.length()
	if step.length_squared() > 0.000001:
		_facing = step.normalized()


func _inner_arena() -> Rect2:
	var margin := Vector2(minf(RADIUS, maxf(arena.size.x, 0.0) * 0.5), minf(RADIUS, maxf(arena.size.y, 0.0) * 0.5))
	return Rect2(arena.position + margin, (arena.size - margin * 2.0).max(Vector2.ZERO))


func _bounded(p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	var inner := _inner_arena()
	return p.clamp(inner.position, inner.end)


func _draw() -> void:
	if not _alive:
		return
class_name Pickups
extends Node2D
## Предметы на полу: аптечка, оружейный ящик, редкая деталь и кровавый контейнер.
## Лежат, покачиваются, подбираются касанием (не магнитом). Обычные исчезают через 40 с
## с миганием в последние 5 с, контейнер лежит, пока его не возьмут. Без нод на предмет.

signal collected(kind: int, pos: Vector2)

enum Kind { MEDKIT, CRATE, PART, CONTAINER }

const TEXTURES := ["medkit", "weapon_crate", "rare_part", "blood_container"]
const GLOWS := [Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.5), Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.3), Color(0.4, 0.7, 1.0), Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.15)]
const GLOW_RADIUS := [7.0, 8.0, 7.0, 13.0]
const TOUCH_RADIUS := [7.0, 8.0, 7.0, 12.0] # радиус предмета; к нему добавляется Player.RADIUS
const LIFETIME := 40.0
const BLINK_TIME := 5.0
const FALL_TIME := 0.55 # контейнер падает сверху
const FALL_HEIGHT := 90.0
const MAX_ITEMS := 64

var player: Player
var effects: Effects
var floor_decals: FloorDecals
var camera: GameCamera

var count := 0
var _pos := PackedVector2Array()
var _kind := PackedByteArray()
var _life := PackedFloat32Array() # сколько ещё лежит; контейнер не исчезает
var _fall := PackedFloat32Array() # сколько ещё падает (0 — лежит)
var _phase := PackedFloat32Array()
var _tex: Array[Texture2D] = []
var _time := 0.0


func _ready() -> void:
	for n: String in TEXTURES:
		_tex.append(PixelArt.tex(n))


## Кладёт предмет в точку p. Контейнер сначала падает с «неба» и приземляется с тряской.
func spawn(p: Vector2, kind: int) -> void:
	if count >= MAX_ITEMS:
		# место кончилось: убираем самый старый обычный предмет
		var oldest := -1
		for i in count:
			if _kind[i] != Kind.CONTAINER and (oldest < 0 or _life[i] < _life[oldest]):
				oldest = i
		if oldest >= 0:
			_remove(oldest)
		if count >= MAX_ITEMS:
			return
	_pos.append(p)
	_kind.append(kind)
	_life.append(INF if kind == Kind.CONTAINER else LIFETIME)
	_fall.append(FALL_TIME if kind == Kind.CONTAINER else 0.0)
	_phase.append(randf() * TAU)
	count += 1


## Ближайший предмет (кроме аптечек) для автопилота симуляции или Vector2.INF.
func nearest(p: Vector2, max_dist: float) -> Vector2:
	var best := Vector2.INF
	var best_d := max_dist * max_dist
	for i in count:
		var d := _pos[i].distance_squared_to(p)
		if _kind[i] != Kind.MEDKIT and _fall[i] <= 0.0 and d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = _pos[i]
	return best


func count_of(kind: int) -> int:
	var n := 0
	for i in count:
		if _kind[i] == kind:
			n += 1
	return n


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	_time += delta
	var i := count - 1
	while i >= 0:
		if _fall[i] > 0.0:
			_fall[i] -= delta
			if _fall[i] <= 0.0:
				_fall[i] = 0.0
				_land(_pos[i])
			i -= 1
			continue
		_life[i] -= delta
		if _life[i] <= 0.0:
			_remove(i)
			i -= 1
			continue
		if player != null and not player.is_dead and _touched(i):
			var k := _kind[i]
			var at := _pos[i]
			_remove(i)
			collected.emit(k, at)
		i -= 1
	queue_redraw()


func _touched(i: int) -> bool:
	var k := _kind[i]
	if k == Kind.MEDKIT and player.hp >= player.max_hp:
		return false # здоровому аптечка не нужна — пусть лежит
	var r: float = Player.RADIUS + TOUCH_RADIUS[k]
	return _pos[i].distance_squared_to(player.global_position) <= r * r


## Приземление контейнера: тряска, пыль, брызги и лужа вокруг.
func _land(p: Vector2) -> void:
	if camera:
		camera.shake(6.0)
	if effects:
		for k in 8:
			effects.blood_burst(p, Vector2.from_angle(TAU * k / 8.0 + randf() * 0.4), 8, 170.0, 0.5)
		for k in 10:
			effects.emit(p, Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(20.0, 70.0), randf_range(0.4, 0.8),
				Color(0.45, 0.42, 0.4, 0.5), 3.0, 4.0)
	if floor_decals:
		floor_decals.pool(PixelArt.tex("blood_%d" % (randi() % 8)), p, randf() * TAU, 2.0)


func _remove(i: int) -> void:
	count -= 1
	_pos[i] = _pos[count]
	_kind[i] = _kind[count]
	_life[i] = _life[count]
	_fall[i] = _fall[count]
	_phase[i] = _phase[count]
	_pos.resize(count)
	_kind.resize(count)
	_life.resize(count)
	_fall.resize(count)
	_phase.resize(count)


func _draw() -> void:
	var k := PixelArt.ART_SCALE
	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self, 40.0)
	for i in count:
		if not view.has_point(_pos[i]):
			continue
		draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO) # после прошлого предмета остался масштаб
		var kind := _kind[i]
		var tex := _tex[kind]
		var p := _pos[i]
		var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(_time * 4.0 + _phase[i])
		if _fall[i] > 0.0:
			# падение: тень растёт, предмет снижается
			var f := _fall[i] / FALL_TIME
			PixelArt.draw_dot(self, p, GLOW_RADIUS[kind] * (1.0 - f * 0.6), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45 * (1.0 - f)))
			draw_set_transform(p + Vector2(0.0, -FALL_HEIGHT * f * f), 0.0, Vector2(k, k))
			draw_texture(tex, -tex.get_size() * 0.5)
			continue
		if _life[i] < BLINK_TIME and int(_life[i] * 8.0) % 2 == 0:
			continue # мигание перед исчезновением
		# тень и свечение: на кровавом полу предмет должен читаться издалека
		PixelArt.draw_dot(self, p + Vector2(0.0, 2.0), TOUCH_RADIUS[kind] * 0.8, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35))
		PixelArt.draw_dot(self, p, GLOW_RADIUS[kind] * (1.0 + 0.15 * pulse), Color(GLOWS[kind], 0.25 + 0.15 * pulse))
		var bob := Vector2(0.0, -0.8 * pulse - 1.0)
		var tilt := 0.0 if kind == Kind.CONTAINER else sin(_time * 2.0 + _phase[i]) * 0.1
		draw_set_transform(p + bob, tilt, Vector2(k, k))
		draw_texture(tex, -tex.get_size() * 0.5)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
	_blast[b] = -1
	_bdepth[b] = depth
	bullet_count += 1


func _update_bullets(delta: float) -> void:
	var i := bullet_count - 1
	while i >= 0:
		var p0 := _bpos[i]
		var v := _bvel[i]
		var p1 := p0 + v * delta
		_blife[i] -= delta
		var probe := p0.lerp(p1, 0.5)
		var hit := _find_hit_except(probe, _blast[i])
		if hit == -1:
			probe = p1
			hit = _find_hit_except(probe, _blast[i])
		if _boss_active and _blast[i] != BOSS_TARGET:
			var nearest := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(boss.global_position, p0, p1)
			if boss.hit_test(nearest, BULLET_RADIUS) and (hit == -1 or p0.distance_squared_to(nearest) < p0.distance_squared_to(probe)):
				hit = BOSS_TARGET
				probe = nearest
		if hit != -1:
			if not _bullet_hit(i, hit, probe):
				_remove_bullet(i)
				i -= 1
				continue
		elif _blife[i] <= 0.0:
			_remove_bullet(i)
			i -= 1
			continue
		_bpos[i] = probe if hit != -1 else p1
		i -= 1


func _find_hit_except(p: Vector2, last_uid: int) -> int:
	var hit := horde.find_hit(p, BULLET_RADIUS)
	if hit != -1 and horde.uid[hit] == last_uid:
		return -1
	return hit
		_rail_beam(i, muzzle, Vector2.from_angle(a), s.stats["damage"] * s.shot_mult, int(s.mod_value(WeaponDefs.Module.RICOCHET, [1, 2, 3])), PackedInt32Array())


func _rail_beam(i: int, from: Vector2, dir: Vector2, dmg: float, bounces: int, hit_uids: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
	var s := slots[i]
	var length: float = s.stats["range"]
	var half: float = s.stats["width"] * 0.5 + Horde.RADIUS
	var to := from + dir * length
	# кто на линии: сортируем по расстоянию вдоль луча
	var hits: Array = []
	if _boss_active and not hit_uids.has(BOSS_TARGET):
		var nearest := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(boss.global_position, from, to)
		if boss.hit_test(nearest, float(s.stats["width"]) * 0.5):
			hits.append([from.distance_to(nearest), BOSS_TARGET])
	for e in horde.count:
		if horde.dead[e] == 1 or hit_uids.has(horde.uid[e]):
			continue
		var rel := horde.pos[e] - from
		var t := rel.dot(dir)
		if t < 0.0 or t > length:
			continue
		if absf(rel.cross(dir)) <= half:
			hits.append([t, e])
	hits.sort_custom(func(x, y): return x[0] < y[0])
	var last := -1
	for h in hits:
		var e: int = h[1]
		if e == BOSS_TARGET:
			hit_uids.append(BOSS_TARGET)
			if last == -1 and s.mod_rank(WeaponDefs.Module.SPLIT) > 0:
				_spawn_shards(i, boss.global_position, dir, dmg, BOSS_TARGET)
			_hit_boss(i, dmg, dir, boss.global_position, "rail")
			last = BOSS_TARGET
			continue
		if horde.dead[e] == 1:
			continue
		hit_uids.append(horde.uid[e])
		var at := horde.pos[e]
		if last == -1 and s.mod_rank(WeaponDefs.Module.SPLIT) > 0:
			_spawn_shards(i, at, dir, dmg, horde.uid[e])
		if _hit_enemy(i, e, dmg, dir, at, s.stats["knock"], false, s.shot_gibs):
			_on_kill(i, e, dir, 0)
		last = e
	var color := Color(0.6, 0.95, 1.0) if s.prototype == 1 else Color(0.55, 0.85, 1.0)
	if s.shot_charged:
		color = Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.35) # усиленный луч «Копья» горячий
	_beams.append([from, to, s.stats["width"], 0.0, color])
	# рикошет: луч перескакивает с последней цели на ближайшую новую
	if bounces > 0 and last != -1:
		var at := _target_position(last)
		var next := _nearest_target(at, 160.0, hit_uids)
		if next != -1:
			_rail_beam(i, at, (_target_position(next) - at).normalized(), dmg * 0.7, bounces - 1, hit_uids)


# --- гранатомёт --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _fire_grenades(i: int, muzzle: Vector2, target: Vector2) -> void:
	var s := slots[i]
	var n: int = s.stats["proj"]
	var flags := (G_LAST if s.shot_gibs else 0) | (G_STICKY if s.trait_id == "sticky" else 0)
	for k in n:
		var t := target + (Vector2(randf_range(-14, 14), randf_range(-14, 14)) if k > 0 else Vector2.ZERO)
		if player.manual_aim and k > 0:
			t = player.global_position + (t - player.global_position).limit_length(float(s.stats["range"]))
		_spawn_grenade(muzzle, t, i, s.stats["damage"] * s.shot_mult, s.stats["radius"], false, flags)


func _spawn_grenade(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, slot: int, dmg: float, radius: float, small: bool, flags := 0) -> void:
	var d := to - from
	var spd: float = slots[slot].stats["speed"] if not small else 180.0
	_gpos.append(from)
	_gvel.append(d.normalized() * spd)
	_gleft.append(d.length())
	_gslot.append(slot)
	_gdmg.append(dmg)
	_grad.append(radius)
	_gsmall.append(1 if small else 0)
	_gflag.append(flags)


func _update_grenades(delta: float) -> void:
	var i := _gpos.size() - 1
	while i >= 0:
		var step := _gvel[i].length() * delta
		_gleft[i] -= step
		_gpos[i] += _gvel[i] * delta
		var touched := horde.find_hit(_gpos[i], 2.0) != -1
		if _boss_active and boss.hit_test(_gpos[i], 2.0):
			touched = true
		if _gleft[i] <= 0.0 or touched:
			var at := _gpos[i]
			var slot := _gslot[i]
			if _gflag[i] & G_STICKY != 0 and _gsmall[i] == 0:
				_stick(at, slot, _gdmg[i], _grad[i], _gflag[i])
			else:
				_detonate(at, slot, _gdmg[i], _grad[i], _gsmall[i] == 1, _gflag[i])
			_gpos.remove_at(i)
			_gvel.remove_at(i)
			_gleft.remove_at(i)
			_gslot.remove_at(i)
			_gdmg.remove_at(i)
			_grad.remove_at(i)
			_gsmall.remove_at(i)
			_gflag.remove_at(i)
		i -= 1


## Взрыв гранаты ствола; сплит у гранатомёта — кассета мини-гранат.
func _detonate(at: Vector2, slot: int, dmg: float, radius: float, small: bool, flags: int) -> void:
	explode(at, dmg, radius, slot, 0, flags & G_LAST != 0)
	if not small and slot < slots.size() and slots[slot].mod_rank(WeaponDefs.Module.SPLIT) > 0:
		var n := 2 + slots[slot].mod_rank(WeaponDefs.Module.SPLIT)
		for k in n:
			var to := at + Vector2.from_angle(TAU * k / n + randf() * 0.5) * randf_range(20.0, 34.0)
			_spawn_grenade(at, to, slot, dmg * 0.4, radius * 0.6, true)


## «Улей»: граната прилипает к врагу (или боссу, иначе к земле) и рвётся через STICKY_FUSE.
func _stick(at: Vector2, slot: int, dmg: float, radius: float, flags: int) -> void:
	var carrier := 0
	var off := Vector2.ZERO
	var e := horde.find_hit(at, 2.0)
	if e != -1:
		carrier = horde.uid[e]


## «Адреналин»: рывок зарядил все стволы.
func _on_adrenaline() -> void:
	weapons.refill_all()
	for k in 10:
		effects.emit(player.global_position, Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(20.0, 70.0), randf_range(0.2, 0.4), Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.7), 1.5, 4.0)


func _on_enemy_killed(pos: Vector2, _dir: Vector2, _death: int, _facing: float, _variant: int) -> void:
	kills += 1
	combo += 1
	best_combo = maxi(best_combo, combo)
	_combo_timer = COMBO_WINDOW
	if COMBO_TITLES.has(combo):
		_announce(COMBO_TITLES[combo])
	if time - _burst_t < MULTIKILL_WINDOW:
		_burst_count += 1
		if _burst_count in [4, 6, 10, 15]:
			_announce("МУЛЬТИКИЛЛ ×%d" % _burst_count)
	else:
		_burst_count = 1
	_burst_t = time
	if pos.distance_to(player.global_position) < DIRT_RADIUS:
		player.add_dirt(1.0)


## Дроп по типу врага (таблица Horde.KINDS), тревога удваивает опыт и кредиты.
func _on_enemy_died(pos: Vector2, kind: int, is_elite: bool) -> void:
	if is_elite:
		elites_killed += 1
	var mult := roundi(blood_alarm.reward_mult())
	var xp_before := gems.spawned_total
	var credits_before := credit_drops.spawned_total
	var def: Dictionary = Horde.KINDS[kind]
	if is_elite:
		gems.spawn(pos, Horde.ELITE_XP * mult)
		credit_drops.spawn(pos, Horde.ELITE_CREDITS * mult) # у элитки кредиты гарантированы
		if randf() < CRATE_CHANCE_ELITE:
			pickups.spawn(_scatter(pos), Pickups.Kind.CRATE)
		if randf() < PART_CHANCE_ELITE:
			pickups.spawn(_scatter(pos), Pickups.Kind.PART)
	else:
		gems.spawn(pos, int(def["xp"]) * mult)
		if randf() < float(def["credit_chance"]):
			credit_drops.spawn(pos, int(def["credits"]) * mult)
	if randf() < (MEDKIT_CHANCE_ELITE if is_elite else MEDKIT_CHANCE):
		pickups.spawn(_scatter(pos), Pickups.Kind.MEDKIT)
	if mult > 1:
		_alarm_xp += gems.spawned_total - xp_before
		_alarm_credits += credit_drops.spawned_total - credits_before


func _scatter(p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	return p + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(0.0, DROP_SCATTER)


## Граната игрока приземлилась: взрыв без привязки к стволу, рвёт на гибы.
func _on_grenade_landed(at: Vector2) -> void:
	nades += 1
	weapons.explode(at, Player.GRENADE_DAMAGE, Player.GRENADE_RADIUS)


## Контейнер тревоги упал: он лежит до подбора (см. Pickups).
func _on_container_dropped(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	_announce(_dispatch_line("supply"), Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.35))
	_alarm_end_t = time
	pickups.spawn(pos, Pickups.Kind.CONTAINER)
	if _alarm and _shot_path != "":
		player.autopilot = false # даём снять приземлившийся контейнер до автоподбора
	if _sim or _alarm:
		print("CONTAINER dropped pos=%s time=%02d:%02d" % [pos, int(time) / 60, int(time) % 60])
		print("ALARM rewards mult=2 xp=%d credits=%d" % [_alarm_xp, _alarm_credits])

func _on_boss_died(at: Vector2) -> void:
	if game_over:
		return
	game_over = true
	spawner.enabled = false
	weapons.firing_enabled = false
	player.set_physics_process(false)
	player.god_mode = true

	# Индексы орды стабильны до конца физического тика.
	var previous := horde.death_override
	horde.death_override = Gore.Death.GIBS
	for i in horde.query_radius(at, 200.0):
		if horde.dead[i] == 0:
			horde.damage(i, 99999.0, (horde.pos[i] - at).normalized(), 250.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.STANDARD, false, horde.pos[i], true)
	horde.death_override = previous
	if _boss_test:
		print("BOSS death cpu: burst=%.2f ms, total handler=%.2f ms" % [_boss_dbg_burst_ms, (Time.get_ticks_usec() - _boss_death_usec) / 1000.0])
	_announce(_dispatch_line("boss"), Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.35))
	if _boss_test or _sim:
		print("BOSS killed fight_s=%.2f military_crates=%d" % [time - _boss_started, military_crates])
		print("MISSION_RESULT outcome=victory time=%.2f kills=%d peak=%d level=%d damage=%.2f" % [time, kills, _run_peak, progression.level, player.damage_taken])
	get_tree().paused = true
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15, true, false, true).timeout
	Engine.time_scale = 0.25
	get_tree().paused = false
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.6, true, false, true).timeout
	Engine.time_scale = 1.0
	if _boss_test:
		# Снимок смерти — когда куски долетели и запеклись в пол, перед самым экраном итогов.
		await get_tree().create_timer(1.15, true, false, true).timeout
		await _boss_screenshot("death")
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.6, true, false, true).timeout
	else:
		await get_tree().create_timer(1.75, true, false, true).timeout
	_open_results(true)
	if _boss_test:
		await get_tree().create_timer(1.5, true, false, true).timeout
		await _boss_screenshot("results")

class_name FloorDecals
extends Node2D
## Пол как «холст бойни». Два постоянных слоя, которые никогда не очищаются:
##
## 1. Слой крови хранит не цвет, а ТОЛЩИНУ (R) и СВЕЖЕСТЬ (G). Штампы складываются
##    аддитивно — лужи сливаются, в центре кровь гуще. Шейдер blood.gdshader
##    раскрашивает толщину: тонкий край — полупрозрачный алый, густое — почти
##    чёрно-бордовое, на свежем — влажный блик и тёмный ободок. Раз в секунду
##    свежесть всего слоя умножается на коэффициент — кровь буреет и тускнеет.
## 2. Слой декалей: трупы, гибы, пепел, лёд — обычные цветные спрайты.
##
## Оба слоя — SubViewport размером с арену × плотность арта. В кадре, когда есть
## новые штампы, рисуются только они и ложатся поверх старого.
## Сетка мокроты на CPU помнит, где недавно пролилась кровь, — по ней оставляют следы.

const DRY_INTERVAL := 1.0 # сек между проходами высыхания
const DRY_FACTOR := 0.965 # свежесть ×0.965 в секунду → бурая примерно за минуту
const POOL_STEPS := 7 # из скольких слоёв растекается лужа
const POOL_TIME := 2.4 # сек, за которые лужа растекается
const WET_CELL := 8.0
const WET_WINDOW := 30.0 # сколько секунд по пятну можно наследить

var stamps_total := 0
var time := 0.0

var _origin := Vector2.ZERO

var _canvas: Node2D

var _blood_canvas: Node2D

# цветные штампы: [текстура, позиция, поворот, масштаб, цвет]

# кровь: [0, текстура, позиция, поворот, масштаб, толщина] | [1, позиция, радиус, толщина]
#        | [2, от, до, ширина, толщина]

func setup(rect: Rect2) -> void:
	process_priority = 100 # после всех, кто штампует в этом кадре
	_origin = rect.position

	# слой крови (под декалями)
	_blood_vp = _make_viewport(rect)
	_blood_canvas = Node2D.new()
	var add_mat := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
	add_mat.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	_blood_canvas.material = add_mat
	_blood_canvas.draw.connect(_on_blood_draw)
	_blood_vp.add_child(_blood_canvas)
	_dry_node = Node2D.new()
	var mul_mat := CanvasItemMaterial.new()
	mul_mat.blend_mode = CanvasItemMaterial.BLEND_MODE_MUL
	_dry_node.material = mul_mat
	_dry_node.draw.connect(_on_dry_draw)
	_blood_vp.add_child(_dry_node)
	var blood_view := _make_view(_blood_vp, rect)
	var shader_mat := ShaderMaterial.new()
	shader_mat.shader = preload("res://shaders/blood.gdshader")
	blood_view.material = shader_mat

	# слой декалей
	_vp = _make_viewport(rect)
	_canvas = Node2D.new()
	_canvas.draw.connect(_on_canvas_draw)
	_vp.add_child(_canvas)
	_make_view(_vp, rect)

	_grid_w = ceili(rect.size.x / WET_CELL)
	_grid_h = ceili(rect.size.y / WET_CELL)
	_wet_time.resize(_grid_w * _grid_h)
	_wet_time.fill(-1000.0)
	_print_tex = PixelArt.tex("footprint")


func _make_viewport(rect: Rect2) -> SubViewport:
	var vp := SubViewport.new()
	vp.size = Vector2i(rect.size * PixelArt.ART_DENSITY) # плотность как у спрайтов
	vp.transparent_bg = true
	vp.disable_3d = true
	vp.canvas_item_default_texture_filter = Viewport.DEFAULT_CANVAS_ITEM_TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST
	vp.render_target_clear_mode = SubViewport.CLEAR_MODE_ONCE
	vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
	add_child(vp)
	vp.canvas_transform = Transform2D.IDENTITY.scaled(Vector2.ONE * PixelArt.ART_DENSITY) # только после входа в дерево
	return vp


func _make_view(vp: SubViewport, rect: Rect2) -> Sprite2D:
	var view := Sprite2D.new()
	view.texture = vp.get_texture()
	view.centered = false
	view.position = rect.position
	view.scale = Vector2.ONE * PixelArt.ART_SCALE
	add_child(view)
	return view


# --- цветные декали ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Сразу в слой декалей (трупы, гибы, пепел, лёд).
func stamp(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, color: Color, scale_factor := 1.0) -> void:
	_stamps.append([tex, pos - _origin, rot, scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE, color])


# --- кровь -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Пятно крови по маске толщины (белое — густо).
func blood(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, scale_factor := 1.0, thickness := 0.6) -> void:
	if gore_multiplier < 1.0 and randf() > gore_multiplier:
		return
	_blood.append([0, tex, pos - _origin, rot, scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE, thickness])
	mark_wet(pos, tex.get_size().x * 0.35 * scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE)


## Капля.
func stamp_dot(pos: Vector2, size: float, _color := Color.WHITE) -> void:
	if gore_multiplier < 1.0 and randf() > gore_multiplier:
		return
	_blood.append([1, pos - _origin, size * 0.45, 0.55])


## Сплошной мазок от a до b — след волочащегося тела или куска.
func smear(a: Vector2, b: Vector2, width: float, thickness := 0.35) -> void:
	if gore_multiplier < 1.0 and randf() > gore_multiplier:
		return
	_blood.append([2, a - _origin, b - _origin, width, thickness])


## След ноги: отпечаток подошвы, повёрнутый по направлению шага.
func stamp_print(pos: Vector2, angle: float, strength: float) -> void:
	if gore_multiplier < 1.0 and randf() > gore_multiplier:
		return
	_blood.append([0, _print_tex, pos - _origin, angle, PixelArt.ART_SCALE, 0.4 * strength])


## Лужа, которая растекается: несколько растущих слоёв, центр получается гуще краёв.
func pool(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, scale_factor := 1.0) -> void:
	if gore_multiplier < 1.0 and randf() > gore_multiplier:
		return
	_pool_tex.append(tex)
	_pool_pos.append(pos)
	_pool_rot.append(rot)
	_pool_scale.append(scale_factor)
	_pool_age.append(0.0)
	_pool_step.append(0)


func mark_wet(pos: Vector2, radius: float) -> void:
	var p := pos - _origin
	var r := ceili(radius / WET_CELL)
	var cx := int(p.x / WET_CELL)
	var cy := int(p.y / WET_CELL)
	for y in range(maxi(cy - r, 0), mini(cy + r + 1, _grid_h)):
		for x in range(maxi(cx - r, 0), mini(cx + r + 1, _grid_w)):
			_wet_time[x + y * _grid_w] = time


func is_wet(pos: Vector2) -> bool:
	var p := pos - _origin
	var x := int(p.x / WET_CELL)
	var y := int(p.y / WET_CELL)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= _grid_w or y >= _grid_h:
		return false
	return time - _wet_time[x + y * _grid_w] < WET_WINDOW


func pool_count() -> int:
	return _pool_tex.size()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	time += delta
	_grow_pools(delta)
	_dry_t += delta
	if _dry_t >= DRY_INTERVAL:
		_dry_t = 0.0
		_dry_now = true

	stamps_last_frame = _stamps.size() + _blood.size()
	if not _stamps.is_empty():
		_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
		_canvas.queue_redraw()
	if not _blood.is_empty() or _dry_now:
		# оба узла перерисовываем всегда: иначе их прошлые команды повторятся в этом кадре
		_blood_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
		_blood_canvas.queue_redraw()
		_dry_node.queue_redraw()


func _grow_pools(delta: float) -> void:
	var i := _pool_tex.size() - 1
	while i >= 0:
		_pool_age[i] += delta
		# слои ложатся всё шире, быстрее в начале
		while _pool_step[i] < POOL_STEPS and _pool_age[i] >= POOL_TIME * pow(float(_pool_step[i]) / POOL_STEPS, 1.6):
			var t := float(_pool_step[i] + 1) / POOL_STEPS
			blood(_pool_tex[i], _pool_pos[i], _pool_rot[i], _pool_scale[i] * lerpf(0.35, 1.0, t), 0.2)
			_pool_step[i] += 1
		if _pool_step[i] >= POOL_STEPS:
			_pool_tex.remove_at(i)
			_pool_pos.remove_at(i)
			_pool_rot.remove_at(i)
			_pool_scale.remove_at(i)
			_pool_age.remove_at(i)
			_pool_step.remove_at(i)
		i -= 1


func _on_blood_draw() -> void:
	var dot := PixelArt.dot()
	for s: Array in _blood:
		var thick: float = s[s.size() - 1]
		var c := Color(thick, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0) # R — толщина, G — свежесть
		match s[0]:
			0:
extends Node2D
## Пол арены: тайл асфальта + разметка и бетонная граница.

var arena := Rect2()


func setup(rect: Rect2) -> void:
	arena = rect
	var floor_sprite := Sprite2D.new()
	floor_sprite.texture = PixelArt.tex("asphalt")
	floor_sprite.centered = false
	floor_sprite.texture_repeat = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_REPEAT_ENABLED
	floor_sprite.region_enabled = true
	floor_sprite.region_rect = Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, rect.size * PixelArt.ART_DENSITY)
	floor_sprite.position = rect.position
	floor_sprite.scale = Vector2(PixelArt.ART_SCALE, PixelArt.ART_SCALE)
	floor_sprite.show_behind_parent = true
	add_child(floor_sprite)
	queue_redraw()


func _draw() -> void:
	if arena.size == Vector2.ZERO:
		return
	var paint := Color(0.75, 0.62, 0.2, 0.55)
	# пунктирная разметка: две дороги крест-накрест
	var cy := arena.get_center().y
	var cx := arena.get_center().x
	var x := arena.position.x
	while x < arena.end.x:
		draw_rect(Rect2(x, cy - 1.0, 24.0, 2.0), paint)
		x += 48.0
	var y := arena.position.y
	while y < arena.end.y:
		draw_rect(Rect2(cx - 1.0, y, 2.0, 24.0), paint)
		y += 48.0
	# бетонная стена по краю
	draw_rect(arena.grow(-4.0), Color(0.42, 0.42, 0.4), false, 8.0)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if game_over:
		return
	time += delta
	_run_peak = maxi(_run_peak, horde.count)
	if _audio_lowhp:
		player.hp = player.max_hp * 0.2
	if _audio_test and time < 36.0 and horde.count < 300:
		for k in mini(15, 300 - horde.count):
			horde.spawn(player.position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(100.0, 330.0), randi() % 4, randf() < 0.025)
	if not _bench and not _ui_test and not _s3_test and not _weapons_test:
		_boss_timeline()
	if _boss_test and boss.is_alive():
		# Чередуем сближение и отход; автопилот не стоит в упор весь бой.
		var away := (player.global_position - boss.global_position).normalized()
		var distance := 160.0 + 100.0 * sin((time - _boss_started) * 0.22)
		player.auto_target = boss.global_position + away * distance + away.orthogonal() * 70.0
	if _sim:
		player.auto_target = pickups.nearest(player.global_position, 400.0)
		if player.auto_target == Vector2.INF:
			player.auto_target = gems.nearest(player.global_position, 260.0)
		_sim_grenade()
		_sim_peak = maxi(_sim_peak, horde.count)
		if player.adrenaline and weapons.any_reloading():
			player.try_dash() # «Адреналин» используется как в живой игре: рывок, когда стволы на перезарядке
	if _mortal:
		_mortal_step()
	horde.minutes = time / 60.0
	spawner.time = time
	blood_alarm.time = time

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if blood_alarm.phase != _dispatch_alarm_phase:
		if blood_alarm.phase == BloodAlarm.Phase.WARN or (blood_alarm.phase == BloodAlarm.Phase.ACTIVE and _dispatch_alarm_phase != BloodAlarm.Phase.WARN):
			_announce(_dispatch_line("alarm"))
		_dispatch_alarm_phase = blood_alarm.phase
	mission_banner_t = maxf(0.0, mission_banner_t - delta)
	if not _dispatch_started and mission_banner_t <= 0.0:
		_dispatch_started = true
		_announce(_dispatch_line("start"), Color(0.75, 0.85, 0.8))
	boss_phase_flash = maxf(0.0, boss_phase_flash - delta)
	if _boss_reward_pos != Vector2.INF:
		_boss_reward_age += delta
		_boss_reward.queue_redraw()
	if _boss_test:
		_boss_test_step()
	if _bench:
		_bench_step(delta)
	if _alarm:
		_alarm_step(delta)
	_combo_timer -= delta
	if _combo_timer <= 0.0:
		combo = 0
	announce_t = maxf(announce_t - delta, 0.0)
	screen_blood.low_hp = 0.0 # мягкая виньетка теперь рисуется под HUD

## Доступ к спрайтам из art/ (их рисует tools/gen_art.py) и общие константы арта.
##
## Арт нарисован с тройной детализацией: 3 пикселя спрайта на 1 игровую единицу
## (персонаж — 48×48 px = 16 единиц). Всё рисуется с масштабом ART_SCALE,
## камера на 1080p показывает мир с zoom 3 — пиксель арта = пиксель экрана.

const ART_SCALE := 1.0 / 3.0
const ART_DENSITY := 3.0 # пикселей арта на игровую единицу
const CELL := Vector2(48, 48) # ячейка персонажа в листах
const VARIANT_COUNT := 7
const ANIM_FRAMES := 4
const VARIANT_NAMES := ["гражданский", "учёный", "солдат", "рабочий", "бегун", "толстяк", "плевальщик"]
const CORPSE_POSES := 3

## Биты ран на живом зомби (столбец атласа).
const WOUND_ARM_L := 1
const WOUND_ARM_R := 2
const WOUND_CHEST := 4
const WOUND_HEAD := 8


static var _dot: Texture2D


## Круглая маска для капель и брызг. draw_circle в Godot 4.7 каждый раз
## триангулирует многоугольник на CPU — сотни кругов за кадр стоят десятки мс,
## поэтому капли рисуются этой текстурой через draw_texture_rect.
static func dot() -> Texture2D:
	if _dot == null:
		var img := Image.create_empty(8, 8, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
		for y in 8:
			for x in 8:
				var d := Vector2(x + 0.5, y + 0.5).distance_to(Vector2(4, 4))
				if d <= 3.9:
					img.set_pixel(x, y, Color(1, 1, 1, 1.0 if d < 3.2 else 0.6))
		_dot = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
	return _dot


## Капля радиуса r с центром p на любом CanvasItem.
static func draw_dot(ci: CanvasItem, p: Vector2, r: float, color: Color) -> void:
	ci.draw_texture_rect(dot(), Rect2(p - Vector2(r, r), Vector2(r, r) * 2.0), false, color)


## Видимая часть мира в локальных координатах узла (с запасом): всё, что вне её, не рисуем (P1).
static func view_rect(ci: CanvasItem, margin := 16.0) -> Rect2:
	var screen := Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, ci.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size)
	return (ci.get_global_transform_with_canvas().affine_inverse() * screen).grow(margin)


static func tex(name: String) -> Texture2D:
	return load("res://art/%s.png" % name)


## Кадр из листа: cols × rows ячеек одинакового размера.
static func frame(sheet: Texture2D, col: int, row: int, cell := CELL) -> AtlasTexture:
	var at := AtlasTexture.new()
	at.atlas = sheet
	at.region = Rect2(Vector2(col, row) * cell, cell)
	return at
func _fill_kinds(initial := false) -> void:
	var alive := [0, 0, 0, 0]
	var elites := 0
	for i in horde.count:
		if horde.elite[i] == 1:
			elites += 1
		else:
			alive[horde.kind[i]] += 1
	for k in Horde.Kind.size():
		for j in maxi(0, KINDS_COUNTS[k] - alive[k]):
			var p := horde.spawn_point(player.global_position)
			if initial:
				p = player.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(randf() * TAU) * randf_range(90.0, 270.0)
			horde.spawn(p, k)
	for j in maxi(0, KINDS_ELITES - elites):
		var p := player.global_position + Vector2.from_angle(TAU * (elites + j) / KINDS_ELITES) * 140.0
		horde.spawn(p, (elites + j) % Horde.Kind.size(), true)
	if initial:
		print("KINDS population=400 mix=220/100/40/40 elites=6 total=%d" % horde.count)

+	"cars": 32, "barrels": 20, "checkpoints": 10, "litter": 320,
+	"vehicles": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "roads": [0.5, 0.5], "safe_radius": 200.0}
+
+
+static func generate(layout_seed: int, profile: Dictionary) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = layout_seed
+	var size: Vector2 = profile.get("size", Vector2(2560, 1440))
+	var center := size * 0.5
+	var safe: float = profile.get("safe_radius", 200.0)
+	var roads: Array = profile.get("roads", [0.5, 0.5])
+	var vehicles: Array = profile.get("vehicles", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var occupied := PackedVector2Array()
+	# Машины в двух полосах двух дорог; отдельные развёрнуты после аварии.
+	for i in int(profile.get("cars", 32)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var horizontal := i % 2 == 0
+			var lane := -65.0 if i % 4 < 2 else 65.0
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(120, size.x - 120), size.y * float(roads[1]) + lane)
+			if not horizontal:
+				p = Vector2(size.x * float(roads[0]) + lane, rng.randf_range(110, size.y - 110))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe, 104.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := (0.0 if horizontal else PI * 0.5) + rng.randf_range(-0.17, 0.17)
+			if i % 9 == 0:
+				angle += 0.5
+			result.append({"kind": int(vehicles[i % vehicles.size()]), "pos": p, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	# Открытые блокпосты: линии не соединяются в замкнутый периметр.
+	for i in int(profile.get("checkpoints", 10)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(100, size.x - 100), rng.randf_range(100, size.y - 100))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe + 45.0, 120.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := float(i % 2) * PI * 0.5
+			for j in 3:
+				var at := p + Vector2(float(j - 1) * 49.0, 0).rotated(angle)
+				result.append({"kind": 7 if j < 2 else (8 if i % 2 == 0 else 10), "pos": at, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	for i in int(profile.get("barrels", 20)):
+		var at: Vector2 = result[i % mini(32, result.size())]["pos"]
+		var p := at + Vector2(0, 51.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -51.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 5 if i % 3 != 0 else 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	for i in 12:
+		var p := Vector2(170.0 + float(i % 6) * 430.0, 60.0 if i < 6 else size.y - 60.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 9, "pos": p, "angle": 0.0})
+	for i in int(profile.get("litter", 320)):
+		var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(30, size.x - 30), rng.randf_range(30, size.y - 30))
+		result.append({"kind": 11 + i % 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	return result
+
+
+static func _available(p: Vector2, occupied: PackedVector2Array, center: Vector2, safe: float, gap: float) -> bool:
+	if p.distance_squared_to(center) < (safe + 55.0) * (safe + 55.0):
+		return false
+	for q in occupied:
+		if p.distance_squared_to(q) < gap * gap:
+			return false
+	return true

+class_name Obstacles
+extends Node2D
+## O1: общая сетка, packed-строки, ограниченная очередь детонаций и один атлас.
+
+enum Kind { SEDAN, HATCH, POLICE, JEEP, TRUCK, RED, ACID, JERSEY, BAGS, FENCE, WOOD, TIRES, RUBBISH, PAPER, BOARDS, GLASS, CONE }
+enum State { INTACT, DAMAGED, BURNING, WRECK, GONE }
+const CELL := 16.0
+const ART_CELL := Vector2(288, 144)
+const TILES := 34
+const CAR_RADIUS := 90.0
+const CAR_DAMAGE := 60.0
+const BARREL_RADIUS := 65.0
+const BARREL_DAMAGE := 40.0
+const FLOW_BUDGET := 700
+const NO_PATH := 2147483647
+
+var player: Player
+var horde: Horde
+var hazards: Hazards
+var explosions: Explosions
+var sfx: Sfx
+var arena := Rect2()
+var count := 0
+var pos := PackedVector2Array()
+var half := PackedVector2Array()
+var axis := PackedVector2Array()
+var rotation_angle := PackedFloat32Array()
+var kind := PackedByteArray()
+var state := PackedByteArray()
+var hp := PackedFloat32Array()
+var burn := PackedFloat32Array()
+var blood := PackedByteArray()
+var high := PackedByteArray()
+var round_shape := PackedByteArray()
+var grid_w := 0
+var grid_h := 0
+var near_head := PackedInt32Array()
+var blocked := PackedByteArray()
+var flow := PackedVector2Array()
+var nav_worst_usec := 0
+var collision_worst_usec := 0
+var detonations := 0
+var nav_completed := 0
+var blood_events := 0
+
+var _link_obj := PackedInt32Array()
+var _link_next := PackedInt32Array()
+var _distance := PackedInt32Array()
+var _queue := PackedInt32Array()
+var _qread := 0
+var _qwrite := 0
+var _building := false
+var _target_cell := -1
+var _flow_target := Vector2.ZERO
+var _flow_ready := false
+var _nav_cd := 0.0
+var _los_version := 1
+var _los_stamp := PackedInt32Array()
+var _los_clear := PackedByteArray()
+var _blast_queue := PackedInt32Array()
+var _burning := PackedInt32Array()
+var _fire_tick := 0.0
+var _visual_tick := 0.0
+var _view_cell := Vector2i(-999, -999)
+var _atlas: Texture2D
+var _fire: Texture2D
+var _smoke: Texture2D
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_atlas = PixelArt.tex("obst_atlas")
+	_fire = PixelArt.tex("fx_explosion_medium")
+	_smoke = PixelArt.tex("fx_smoke")
+	process_priority = -20
+	_rng.seed = 17081
+
+
+func setup(rect: Rect2, layout: Array[Dictionary]) -> void:
+	arena = rect
+	count = layout.size()
+	pos.resize(count)
+	half.resize(count)
+	axis.resize(count)
+	rotation_angle.resize(count)
+	kind.resize(count)
+	state.resize(count)
+	hp.resize(count)
+	burn.resize(count)
+	blood.resize(count)
+	high.resize(count)
+	round_shape.resize(count)
+	_burning.clear()
+	_blast_queue.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		kind[i] = int(layout[i]["kind"])
+		pos[i] = layout[i]["pos"]
+		rotation_angle[i] = float(layout[i].get("angle", 0.0))
+		axis[i] = Vector2.from_angle(rotation_angle[i])
+		state[i] = State.INTACT
+		blood[i] = 0
+		burn[i] = 0.0
+		var k := kind[i]
+		half[i] = Vector2(32, 14) if k < Kind.TRUCK else Vector2(42, 16)
+		if k >= Kind.RED:
+			half[i] = Vector2(5.8, 5.8) if k <= Kind.ACID else Vector2(22, 5)
+		if k == Kind.BAGS:
+			half[i] = Vector2(12, 12)
+		if k == Kind.WOOD:
+			half[i] = Vector2(16, 5)
+		high[i] = 1 if k <= Kind.TRUCK or k == Kind.JERSEY or k == Kind.FENCE else 0
+		round_shape[i] = 1 if k in [Kind.RED, Kind.ACID, Kind.BAGS] else 0
+		hp[i] = 120.0 if k <= Kind.TRUCK else 12.0
+	grid_w = ceili(rect.size.x / CELL)
+	grid_h = ceili(rect.size.y / CELL)
+	var n := grid_w * grid_h
+	near_head.resize(n)
+	blocked.resize(n)
+	flow.resize(n)
+	_distance.resize(n)
+	_queue.resize(n)
+	_los_stamp.resize(n)
+	_los_clear.resize(n)
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_nav_cd = 0.0
+	rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func cell_at(p: Vector2) -> int:
+	return clampi(int((p.x - arena.position.x) / CELL), 0, grid_w - 1) + clampi(int((p.y - arena.position.y) / CELL), 0, grid_h - 1) * grid_w
+
+
+func cell_center(c: int) -> Vector2:
+	return arena.position + Vector2(float(c % grid_w) + 0.5, float(c / grid_w) + 0.5) * CELL
+
+
+func rebuild_grid() -> void:
+	near_head.fill(-1)
+	blocked.fill(0)
+	_link_obj.clear()
+	_link_next.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var a := axis[i].abs()
+		var extent := a * half[i].x + Vector2(a.y, a.x) * half[i].y + Vector2.ONE * 34.0
+		var lo := Vector2i((pos[i] - extent - arena.position) / CELL).max(Vector2i.ZERO)
+		var hi := Vector2i((pos[i] + extent - arena.position) / CELL).min(Vector2i(grid_w - 1, grid_h - 1))
+		for y in range(lo.y, hi.y + 1):
+			for x in range(lo.x, hi.x + 1):
+				var c := x + y * grid_w
+				_link_obj.append(i)
+				_link_next.append(near_head[c])
+				near_head[c] = _link_obj.size() - 1
+				# Запас для элитки и диагонали клетки: поток не срезает углы.
+				if _overlaps(i, cell_center(c), 18.9):
+					blocked[c] = 1
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_los_version += 1
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _local(i: int, p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var rel := p - pos[i]
+	var a := axis[i]
+	return Vector2(rel.dot(a), rel.dot(a.orthogonal()))
+
+
+func _overlaps(i: int, p: Vector2, r: float) -> bool:
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		return pos[i].distance_squared_to(p) < (half[i].x + r) * (half[i].x + r)
+	var q := _local(i, p).abs() - half[i]
+	return q.max(Vector2.ZERO).length_squared() < r * r
+
+
+func contains(p: Vector2, r := 0.1) -> bool:
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		if state[i] != State.GONE and _overlaps(i, p, r):
+			return true
+		link = _link_next[link]
+	return false
+
+
+## Узкая фаза только в занятых окрестностях; повтор нужен в стыке двух блоков.
+func resolve(p: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	for pass_index in 4:
+		var changed := false
+		var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if state[i] == State.GONE:
+				continue
+			var q := _local(i, p)
+			if round_shape[i] == 1:
+				var distance := q.length()
+				var reach := half[i].x + r + 0.02
+				if distance >= reach:
+					continue
+				q = q / distance * reach if distance > 0.0001 else Vector2(reach, 0)
+			else:
+				var closest := q.clamp(-half[i], half[i])
+				var away := q - closest
+				var d2 := away.length_squared()
+				if d2 >= (r + 0.02) * (r + 0.02):
+					continue
+				if d2 > 0.000001:
+					q = closest + away * ((r + 0.02) / sqrt(d2))
+				else:
+					var depth := half[i] - q.abs()
+					if depth.x < depth.y:
+						q.x = (half[i].x + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.x >= 0 else -1.0)
+					else:
+						q.y = (half[i].y + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.y >= 0 else -1.0)
+			p = pos[i] + axis[i] * q.x + axis[i].orthogonal() * q.y
+			changed = true
+		if not changed:
+			break
+	return p
+
+
+## Подшаги исключают туннелирование рывка, тарана и сильного отброса.
+func move_actor(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / 4.0))
+	var step := (to - from) / float(steps)
+	var p := from
+	for j in steps:
+		p = resolve(p + step, r)
+	return p
+
+
+func free_point(p: Vector2, r := 8.0) -> Vector2:
+	p = p.clamp(arena.position + Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0), arena.end - Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0))
+	if not contains(p, r):
+		return p
+	var c := Vector2i((p - arena.position) / CELL)
+	for ring in 32:
+		for dy in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+			for dx in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+				if absi(dx) != ring and absi(dy) != ring:
+					continue
+				var q := c + Vector2i(dx, dy)
+				if q.x < 1 or q.y < 1 or q.x >= grid_w - 1 or q.y >= grid_h - 1:
+					continue
+				var at := cell_center(q.x + q.y * grid_w)
+				if not contains(at, r):
+					return at
+	return arena.get_center()
+
+
+## Сегмент против OBB/круга. Возвращает долю луча или INF.
+func _segment(i: int, from: Vector2, to: Vector2, radius: float) -> float:
+	var p := _local(i, from)
+	var v := _local(i, to) - p
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		var rr := half[i].x + radius
+		var a := v.length_squared()
+		var b := p.dot(v)
+		var c := p.length_squared() - rr * rr
+		if c <= 0.0:
+			return 0.0
+		var discriminant := b * b - a * c
+		if a <= 0.000001 or discriminant < 0.0:
+			return INF
+		var t := (-b - sqrt(discriminant)) / a
+		return t if t >= 0.0 and t <= 1.0 else INF
+	var extent := half[i] + Vector2.ONE * radius
+	var low := 0.0
+	var upper := 1.0
+	for dim in 2:
+		if absf(v[dim]) < 0.000001:
+			if absf(p[dim]) > extent[dim]:
+				return INF
+		else:
+			var a := (-extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			var b := (extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			low = maxf(low, minf(a, b))
+			upper = minf(upper, maxf(a, b))
+			if low > upper:
+				return INF
+	return low
+
+
+## Для коротких пуль достаточно бакета середины; длинные лучи проходят сетку.
+func ray_hit(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, only_high := false, radius := 1.0) -> int:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / CELL))
+	var best := -1
+	var best_t := INF
+	var previous := -1
+	for step_index in steps + 1:
+		var c := cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(step_index) / float(steps)))
+		if c == previous:
+			continue
+		previous = c
+		var link := near_head[c]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if state[i] == State.GONE or (only_high and high[i] == 0):
+				continue
+			if not only_high and high[i] == 0 and kind[i] != Kind.RED and kind[i] != Kind.ACID:
+				continue
+			var t := _segment(i, from, to, radius)
+			if t < best_t:
+				best_t = t
+				best = i
+	return best
+
+
+func line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	return ray_hit(from, to, true, 0.0) == -1
+
+
+func steering(p: Vector2, direct: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	if not _flow_ready:
+		return direct
+	var c := cell_at(p)
+	if _los_stamp[c] != _los_version:
+		_los_stamp[c] = _los_version
+		_los_clear[c] = 1 if _nav_line_clear(cell_center(c), _flow_target) else 0
+	if _los_clear[c] == 1:
+		return direct
+	var direction := flow[c]
+	if direction == Vector2.ZERO:
+		# Агент мог быть растолкнут в запас сетки: берёт ближайшую свободную клетку.
+		var best := INF
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next >= 0 and next < blocked.size() and blocked[next] == 0 and _distance[next] < best:
+				best = _distance[next]
+				direction = (cell_center(next) - p).normalized()
+	return direction if direction != Vector2.ZERO else direct
+
+
+func _nav_line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / (CELL * 0.65)))
+	for j in steps + 1:
+		if blocked[cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(j) / float(steps)))] != 0:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func navigation_step(delta: float, target: Vector2) -> void:
+	var start := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_nav_cd -= delta
+	var c := cell_at(free_point(target, 19.0))
+	if not _building and _nav_cd <= 0.0 and c != _target_cell:
+		_target_cell = c
+		_flow_target = cell_center(c)
+		_nav_cd = 0.2
+		_distance.fill(NO_PATH)
+		_distance[c] = 0
+		_queue[0] = c
+		_qread = 0
+		_qwrite = 1
+		_building = true
+	if _building:
+		var end := mini(_qread + FLOW_BUDGET, _qwrite)
+		# Срез бюджета расширяется вместе с FIFO, но не больше FLOW_BUDGET.
+		end = _qread + FLOW_BUDGET
+		while _qread < _qwrite and _qread < end:
+			var at := _queue[_qread]
+			_qread += 1
+			var x := at % grid_w
+			for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+				var next := at + offset
+				if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and x == 0) or (offset == 1 and x == grid_w - 1):
+					continue
+				if blocked[next] != 0 or _distance[next] != NO_PATH:
+					continue
+				_distance[next] = _distance[at] + 1
+				_queue[_qwrite] = next
+				_qwrite += 1
+		if _qread == _qwrite:
+			_building = false
+			_flow_ready = true
+			_los_version += 1
+			nav_completed += 1
+			_build_flow()
+	nav_worst_usec = maxi(nav_worst_usec, Time.get_ticks_usec() - start)
+
+
+func _build_flow() -> void:
+	for c in blocked.size():
+		flow[c] = Vector2.ZERO
+		if blocked[c] != 0 or _distance[c] == NO_PATH or _distance[c] == 0:
+			continue
+		var best := _distance[c]
+		var direction := Vector2.ZERO
+		var x := c % grid_w
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and x == 0) or (offset == 1 and x == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if _distance[next] < best:
+				best = _distance[next]
+				direction = cell_center(next) - cell_center(c)
+			elif _distance[next] == best and best < _distance[c]:
+				direction += cell_center(next) - cell_center(c)
+		flow[c] = direction.normalized()
+
+
+func connected() -> bool:
+	# Независимый flood-fill для проверки профиля, без изменения активного поля.
+	var seen := PackedByteArray()
+	seen.resize(blocked.size())
+	var todo := PackedInt32Array([cell_at(arena.get_center())])
+	seen[todo[0]] = 1
+	var head := 0
+	while head < todo.size():
+		var c := todo[head]
+		head += 1
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and c % grid_w == 0) or (offset == 1 and c % grid_w == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if blocked[next] == 0 and seen[next] == 0:
+				seen[next] = 1
+				todo.append(next)
+	return seen.count(1) == blocked.count(0)
+
+
+func damage(i: int, amount: float, fire := false) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= count or kind[i] > Kind.ACID or state[i] >= State.BURNING:
+		return
+	hp[i] -= amount
+	if hp[i] <= 60.0:
+		state[i] = State.DAMAGED
+	if hp[i] <= 0.0 or (fire and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK):
+		if kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			burn[i] = 4.0 + float(i % 3)
+			_burning.append(i)
+		else:
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func blast(at: Vector2, radius: float, amount: float) -> void:
+	for i in count:
+		if state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var d2 := pos[i].distance_squared_to(at)
+		if d2 > (radius + half[i].x) * (radius + half[i].x):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES:
+			var away := (pos[i] - at).normalized()
+			pos[i] += away * 12.0
+			rotation_angle[i] += 0.7
+		elif kind[i] <= Kind.ACID:
+			damage(i, amount * (1.0 - 0.5 * minf(sqrt(d2) / radius, 1.0)))
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func charge(at: Vector2, radius: float) -> bool:
+	var stopped := false
+	var dirty := false
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(at)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		link = _link_next[link]
+		if state[i] == State.GONE or not _overlaps(i, at, radius):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] == Kind.BAGS or kind[i] == Kind.WOOD:
+			state[i] = State.GONE
+			dirty = true
+		else:
+			damage(i, 180.0, true)
+			stopped = true
+	if dirty:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	return stopped
+
+
+## Кровь выбирает заранее обрезанную по альфе ступень того же атласа.
+func splatter(at: Vector2, _dir := Vector2.ZERO, _death := 0, _facing := 0.0, _variant := 0) -> void:
+	var changed := false
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE or blood[i] >= 3:
+			continue
+		if _overlaps(i, at, 42.0):
+			blood[i] += 1
+			blood_events += 1
+			changed = true
+	if changed:
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if player:
+		navigation_step(delta, player.global_position)
+	_fire_tick -= delta
+	var fire_tick := _fire_tick <= 0.0
+	if fire_tick:
+		_fire_tick = 0.25
+	for n in range(_burning.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var i := _burning[n]
+		burn[i] -= delta
+		if burn[i] <= 0.0:
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+			_burning.remove_at(n)
+		elif fire_tick and horde:
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], half[i].x + 18.0):
+				if _overlaps(i, horde.pos[j], 18.0):
+					horde.ignite(j, 6.0, 2.0)
+	# Снимок FIFO: цепь не рекурсивна, максимум четыре детонации за тик.
+	var n := mini(4, _blast_queue.size())
+	for j in n:
+		var i := _blast_queue[0]
+		_blast_queue.remove_at(0)
+		_detonate(i)
+
+
+func _detonate(i: int) -> void:
+	var car := kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK
+	state[i] = State.WRECK if car else State.GONE
+	detonations += 1
+	if kind[i] == Kind.ACID:
+		if hazards:
+			hazards.acid_pool(pos[i], 32.0, 8.0, 6.0)
+	else:
+		var radius := CAR_RADIUS if car else BARREL_RADIUS
+		var amount := CAR_DAMAGE if car else BARREL_DAMAGE
+		if explosions:
+			explosions.spawn(pos[i], radius, Explosions.Kind.CAR if car else Explosions.Kind.GRENADE)
+		if sfx:
+			sfx.play("explosions/grenade", pos[i], -1.0, 0.02)
+		if horde:
+			var previous := horde.death_override
+			horde.death_override = Gore.Death.GIBS
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], radius):
+				var offset := horde.pos[j] - pos[i]
+				var falloff := 1.0 - 0.5 * minf(offset.length() / radius, 1.0)
+				horde.damage(j, amount * falloff, offset.normalized(), 210.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.STANDARD, false, horde.pos[j], true)
+			horde.death_override = previous
+		if player and player.global_position.distance_squared_to(pos[i]) < radius * radius:
+			player.take_damage(amount)
+		blast(pos[i], radius, amount * 3.0)
+		splatter(pos[i])
+	if not car:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_visual_tick += delta
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self)
+	var cell := Vector2i(view.position / 48.0)
+	if cell != _view_cell or (not _burning.is_empty() and _visual_tick >= 0.083):
+		_view_cell = cell
+		_visual_tick = 0.0
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _tile(i: int) -> int:
+	var k := kind[i]
+	if k <= Kind.TRUCK:
+		return k * 4 + mini(state[i], 3)
+	if k <= Kind.ACID:
+		return 20 + (k - Kind.RED) * 2 + (1 if state[i] == State.DAMAGED else 0)
+	return 24 + k - Kind.JERSEY
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if _atlas == null:
+		return
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self, 130.0)
+	# Мусор в том же пакете, перед высокими объектами.
+	for layer in 2:
+		for i in count:
+			if state[i] == State.GONE or not view.has_point(pos[i]) or (kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES) != (layer == 0):
+				continue
+			var tile := _tile(i) + int(blood[i]) * TILES
+			var source := Rect2(Vector2(tile % 8, tile / 8) * ART_CELL, ART_CELL)
+			draw_set_transform(pos[i], rotation_angle[i], Vector2.ONE * PixelArt.ART_SCALE)
+			draw_texture_rect_region(_atlas, Rect2(-ART_CELL * 0.5, ART_CELL), source)
+	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
+	for i in _burning:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 80 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 18.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-24, -50), Vector2(48, 52)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.54, 0.51, 0.65))
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_fire, Rect2(at - Vector2(16, 30), Vector2(32, 36)), Rect2((frame + 2) * 144, (i % 3) * 144, 144, 144))

var alarm := false # идёт кровавая тревога: берём ALARM_ROW (ставит BloodAlarm)
var elites_spawned := 0 # для отчёта --sim

var _budget := 0.0
var _next_group := 4
var _next_pack := false # следующая группа — пачка бегунов
var _next_elite := ELITE_START
var _wave_angle := 0.0
var _last_directional := false
var profile: Dictionary = {}
var _rows: Array = []
var _alarm_row: Array = []
var _next_hunt := INF


## Бой знает только параметры; география и состояние мира сюда не попадают.
static func combat_profile(config: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	if config.is_empty():
		return {}
	var tier := clampi(int(config["threat"]), 1, 5) - 1
	var mods: Array = config["modifiers"]
	return {"rate_mul": float(MISSION_BALANCE["rate"][tier]) * (float(MISSION_BALANCE["runner_rate"]) if mods.has("runner_surge") else 1.0),
		"runner_add": tier * float(MISSION_BALANCE["runner_step"]) + (float(MISSION_BALANCE["runner_bonus"]) if mods.has("runner_surge") else 0.0),
		"spitter_add": tier * float(MISSION_BALANCE["spitter_step"]), "acid": mods.has("acid_rain"),
		"elite_period": ELITE_PERIOD - tier * float(MISSION_BALANCE["elite_step"]),
		"directional": DIRECTIONAL_CHANCE + tier * float(MISSION_BALANCE["direction_step"]),
		"hunt": mods.has("elite_hunt"), "extra_alarm": mods.has("blood_frenzy"),
		"acid_life_mul": float(MISSION_BALANCE["acid_life"]) if mods.has("acid_rain") else 1.0,
		"boss_hp_mul": float(MISSION_BALANCE["boss_hp"]) if mods.has("hardened_boss") else 1.0,
		"boss_shed": float(MISSION_BALANCE["boss_shed"]) if mods.has("hardened_boss") else 0.5}


func set_profile(value: Dictionary) -> void:
	profile = value.duplicate(true)
	_rows.clear()
	_alarm_row.clear()
	_next_elite = ELITE_START
	_next_hunt = float(MISSION_BALANCE["hunt_start"]) if profile.get("hunt", false) else INF
	if profile.is_empty():
		return
	# Строки считаются один раз, без словарей и копирования в горячем цикле.
	for row: Array in CURVE:
		_rows.append(_mission_row(row))
	_alarm_row = _mission_row(ALARM_ROW)


func _mission_row(source: Array) -> Array:
	var row := source.duplicate(true)
	var shares: Array = row[3]
	var runners := float(profile["runner_add"])
	var spitters := float(profile["spitter_add"]) if float(source[0]) >= 300.0 else 0.0
	if profile["acid"] and float(source[0]) >= 120.0:
		spitters += float(MISSION_BALANCE["acid_bonus"])
	shares[0] = maxi(10, int(shares[0]) - int(runners + spitters))
	shares[1] = int(shares[1]) + int(runners)
	shares[3] = int(shares[3]) + int(spitters)
	row[1] = float(row[1]) * float(profile["rate_mul"])
	return row


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not enabled or horde == null or player.is_dead:
		return
	var row := current_row()
	var rate: float = row[1]
	var cap: int = row[2]
	var shares: Array = row[3]

	if time >= _next_elite:
		var period := float(profile.get("elite_period", ELITE_PERIOD))
		_next_elite += period
		if _next_elite < time: # перемотка времени — не выдаём очередь элиток
			_next_elite = time + period
		spawn_elites(1)
	if time >= _next_hunt:
		_next_hunt = time + float(MISSION_BALANCE["hunt_period"])
		spawn_elites(int(MISSION_BALANCE["hunt_count"]))

	_budget += rate * delta
	# копим «бюджет» и выпускаем зомби группами — так орда читается как волна
	if _budget >= _next_group:
		var room := cap - horde.count
		if room <= 0:
			_budget = minf(_budget, float(_next_group))
			return
		var n := mini(_next_group, room)
		_spawn_group(n, shares)
		_budget -= n
		_roll_group(shares)


## Строка кривой для текущего момента (тревога подменяет её).
func current_row() -> Array:
	if alarm:
		return ALARM_ROW if profile.is_empty() else _alarm_row
	var curve: Array = CURVE if profile.is_empty() else _rows
	var row: Array = curve[0]
	for p: Array in curve:
		if time >= p[0]:
			row = p
	return row


func current_rate() -> float:
	return current_row()[1]


## n элиток сразу (тип — по долям текущей фазы), кольцо вокруг точки спавна.
func spawn_elites(n: int) -> void:
	var shares: Array = current_row()[3]
	var origin := horde.spawn_point(player.global_position)
	var base := randf() * TAU
	for j in n:
		if not profile.is_empty() and horde.count >= int(current_row()[2]):
			break
		var p := origin + Vector2.from_angle(base + TAU * j / maxf(n, 1.0)) * (24.0 if n > 1 else 0.0)

+class_name ArenaLayout
+extends RefCounted
+## Профиль — данные для O2; локальный RNG не меняет случайность боя.
+
+const QUARANTINE := {"name": "quarantine", "size": Vector2(2560, 1440),
+	"cars": 32, "barrels": 20, "checkpoints": 10, "litter": 320,
+	"vehicles": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "roads": [0.5, 0.5], "safe_radius": 200.0}
+
+
+static func generate(layout_seed: int, profile: Dictionary) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = layout_seed
+	var size: Vector2 = profile.get("size", Vector2(2560, 1440))
+	var center := size * 0.5
+	var safe: float = profile.get("safe_radius", 200.0)
+	var roads: Array = profile.get("roads", [0.5, 0.5])
+	var vehicles: Array = profile.get("vehicles", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var occupied := PackedVector2Array()
+	# Машины в двух полосах двух дорог; отдельные развёрнуты после аварии.
+	for i in int(profile.get("cars", 32)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var horizontal := i % 2 == 0
+			var lane := -65.0 if i % 4 < 2 else 65.0
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(120, size.x - 120), size.y * float(roads[1]) + lane)
+			if not horizontal:
+				p = Vector2(size.x * float(roads[0]) + lane, rng.randf_range(110, size.y - 110))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe, 104.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := (0.0 if horizontal else PI * 0.5) + rng.randf_range(-0.17, 0.17)
+			if i % 9 == 0:
+				angle += 0.5
+			result.append({"kind": int(vehicles[i % vehicles.size()]), "pos": p, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	# Открытые блокпосты: линии не соединяются в замкнутый периметр.
+	for i in int(profile.get("checkpoints", 10)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(100, size.x - 100), rng.randf_range(100, size.y - 100))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe + 45.0, 120.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := float(i % 2) * PI * 0.5
+			for j in 3:
+				var at := p + Vector2(float(j - 1) * 49.0, 0).rotated(angle)
+				result.append({"kind": 7 if j < 2 else (8 if i % 2 == 0 else 10), "pos": at, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	for i in int(profile.get("barrels", 20)):
+		var at: Vector2 = result[i % mini(32, result.size())]["pos"]
+		var p := at + Vector2(0, 51.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -51.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 5 if i % 3 != 0 else 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	for i in 12:
+		var p := Vector2(170.0 + float(i % 6) * 430.0, 60.0 if i < 6 else size.y - 60.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 9, "pos": p, "angle": 0.0})
+	for i in int(profile.get("litter", 320)):
+		var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(30, size.x - 30), rng.randf_range(30, size.y - 30))
+		result.append({"kind": 11 + i % 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	return result
+
+
+static func _available(p: Vector2, occupied: PackedVector2Array, center: Vector2, safe: float, gap: float) -> bool:
+	if p.distance_squared_to(center) < (safe + 55.0) * (safe + 55.0):
+		return false
+	for q in occupied:
+		if p.distance_squared_to(q) < gap * gap:
+			return false
+	return true
