+class_name ArenaLayout
+extends RefCounted
+## Профиль — данные для O2; локальный RNG не меняет случайность боя.
+
+const QUARANTINE := {"name": "quarantine", "size": Vector2(2560, 1440),
+	"cars": 32, "barrels": 20, "checkpoints": 10, "litter": 320,
+	"vehicles": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "roads": [0.5, 0.5], "safe_radius": 200.0}
+
+
+static func generate(layout_seed: int, profile: Dictionary) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = layout_seed
+	var size: Vector2 = profile.get("size", Vector2(2560, 1440))
+	var center := size * 0.5
+	var safe: float = profile.get("safe_radius", 200.0)
+	var roads: Array = profile.get("roads", [0.5, 0.5])
+	var vehicles: Array = profile.get("vehicles", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var occupied := PackedVector2Array()
+	# Машины в двух полосах двух дорог; отдельные развёрнуты после аварии.
+	for i in int(profile.get("cars", 32)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var horizontal := i % 2 == 0
+			var lane := -65.0 if i % 4 < 2 else 65.0
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(120, size.x - 120), size.y * float(roads[1]) + lane)
+			if not horizontal:
+				p = Vector2(size.x * float(roads[0]) + lane, rng.randf_range(110, size.y - 110))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe, 104.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := (0.0 if horizontal else PI * 0.5) + rng.randf_range(-0.17, 0.17)
+			if i % 9 == 0:
+				angle += 0.5
+			result.append({"kind": int(vehicles[i % vehicles.size()]), "pos": p, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	# Открытые блокпосты: линии не соединяются в замкнутый периметр.
+	for i in int(profile.get("checkpoints", 10)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(100, size.x - 100), rng.randf_range(100, size.y - 100))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe + 45.0, 120.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := float(i % 2) * PI * 0.5
+			for j in 3:
+				var at := p + Vector2(float(j - 1) * 49.0, 0).rotated(angle)
+				result.append({"kind": 7 if j < 2 else (8 if i % 2 == 0 else 10), "pos": at, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	for i in int(profile.get("barrels", 20)):
+		var at: Vector2 = result[i % mini(32, result.size())]["pos"]
+		var p := at + Vector2(0, 51.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -51.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 5 if i % 3 != 0 else 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	for i in 12:
+		var p := Vector2(170.0 + float(i % 6) * 430.0, 60.0 if i < 6 else size.y - 60.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 9, "pos": p, "angle": 0.0})
+	for i in int(profile.get("litter", 320)):
+		var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(30, size.x - 30), rng.randf_range(30, size.y - 30))
+		result.append({"kind": 11 + i % 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	# Проверяем именно сетку с запасом элитки, которую затем использует орда.
+	var probe := Obstacles.new()
+	for attempt in 40:
+		probe.setup(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), result)
+		var unreachable := probe.unreachable_cell()
+		if unreachable == -1:
+			break
+		var at := probe.cell_center(unreachable)
+		var nearest := -1
+		var distance := INF
+		for i in result.size():
+			if int(result[i]["kind"]) >= 11:
+				continue
+			var d := Vector2(result[i]["pos"]).distance_squared_to(at)
+			if d < distance:
+				nearest = i
+				distance = d
+		if nearest < 0:
+			break
+		var p := Vector2(result[nearest]["pos"]) + Vector2(90, 75).rotated(float(attempt) * 2.4)
+		p = p.clamp(Vector2(95, 95), size - Vector2(95, 95))
+		if p.distance_to(center) < safe + 55.0:
+			p = center + (p - center).normalized() * (safe + 90.0)
+		result[nearest]["pos"] = p
+	probe.free()
+	return result
+
+
+static func _available(p: Vector2, occupied: PackedVector2Array, center: Vector2, safe: float, gap: float) -> bool:
+	if p.distance_squared_to(center) < (safe + 55.0) * (safe + 55.0):
+		return false
+	for q in occupied:
+		if p.distance_squared_to(q) < gap * gap:
+			return false
+	return true

+func scorch(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, scale_factor: float) -> void:
+	var stamp_data := [tex, pos, rot, scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE]
+	if _scorches.size() < 256:
+		_scorches.append(stamp_data)
+	else:
+		_scorches[_scorch_cursor] = stamp_data
+		_scorch_cursor = (_scorch_cursor + 1) % 256
+	_scorch_layer.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw_scorches() -> void:
+	# Три текстуры рисуются группами: старые подпалины не дробят пакет.
+	for variant_index in 3:
+		for s: Array in _scorches:
+			var tex: Texture2D = s[0]
+			if not tex.resource_path.ends_with("_%d.png" % variant_index):
+				continue
+			_scorch_layer.draw_set_transform(s[1], s[2], Vector2.ONE * float(s[3]))
+			_scorch_layer.draw_texture(tex, -tex.get_size() * 0.5)
+	_scorch_layer.draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)

+class_name Obstacles
+extends Node2D
+## O1: общая сетка, packed-строки, ограниченная очередь детонаций и один атлас.
+
+enum Kind { SEDAN, HATCH, POLICE, JEEP, TRUCK, RED, ACID, JERSEY, BAGS, FENCE, WOOD, TIRES, RUBBISH, PAPER, BOARDS, GLASS, CONE }
+enum State { INTACT, DAMAGED, BURNING, WRECK, GONE }
+const CELL := 16.0
+const ART_CELL := Vector2(288, 144)
+const TILES := 34
+const CAR_RADIUS := 90.0
+const CAR_DAMAGE := 60.0
+const BARREL_RADIUS := 65.0
+const BARREL_DAMAGE := 40.0
+const FLOW_BUDGET := 700
+const NO_PATH := 2147483647
+
+var player: Player
+var horde: Horde
+var hazards: Hazards
+var explosions: Explosions
+var sfx: Sfx
+var arena := Rect2()
+var count := 0
+var pos := PackedVector2Array()
+var half := PackedVector2Array()
+var axis := PackedVector2Array()
+var rotation_angle := PackedFloat32Array()
+var kind := PackedByteArray()
+var state := PackedByteArray()
+var hp := PackedFloat32Array()
+var burn := PackedFloat32Array()
+var blood := PackedByteArray()
+var high := PackedByteArray()
+var round_shape := PackedByteArray()
+var grid_w := 0
+var grid_h := 0
+var near_head := PackedInt32Array()
+var blocked := PackedByteArray()
+var flow := PackedVector2Array()
+var nav_worst_usec := 0
+var collision_worst_usec := 0
+var detonations := 0
+var nav_completed := 0
+var blood_events := 0
+
+var _link_obj := PackedInt32Array()
+var _link_next := PackedInt32Array()
+var _distance := PackedInt32Array()
+var _next_flow := PackedVector2Array()
+var _queue := PackedInt32Array()
+var _qread := 0
+var _qwrite := 0
+var _building := false
+var _target_cell := -1
+var _flow_target := Vector2.ZERO
+var _flow_ready := false
+var _nav_cd := 0.0
+var _los_version := 1
+var _los_stamp := PackedInt32Array()
+var _los_clear := PackedByteArray()
+var _blast_queue := PackedInt32Array()
+var _burning := PackedInt32Array()
+var _smoking := PackedInt32Array()
+var _fire_tick := 0.0
+var _visual_tick := 0.0
+var _view_cell := Vector2i(-999, -999)
+var _atlas: Texture2D
+var _fire: Texture2D
+var _smoke: Texture2D
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_atlas = PixelArt.tex("obst_atlas")
+	_fire = PixelArt.tex("fx_explosion_medium")
+	_smoke = PixelArt.tex("fx_smoke")
+	process_priority = -20
+	_rng.seed = 17081
+
+
+func setup(rect: Rect2, layout: Array[Dictionary]) -> void:
+	arena = rect
+	count = layout.size()
+	pos.resize(count)
+	half.resize(count)
+	axis.resize(count)
+	rotation_angle.resize(count)
+	kind.resize(count)
+	state.resize(count)
+	hp.resize(count)
+	burn.resize(count)
+	blood.resize(count)
+	high.resize(count)
+	round_shape.resize(count)
+	_burning.clear()
+	_smoking.clear()
+	_blast_queue.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		kind[i] = int(layout[i]["kind"])
+		pos[i] = layout[i]["pos"]
+		rotation_angle[i] = float(layout[i].get("angle", 0.0))
+		axis[i] = Vector2.from_angle(rotation_angle[i])
+		state[i] = State.INTACT
+		blood[i] = 0
+		burn[i] = 0.0
+		var k := kind[i]
+		half[i] = Vector2(32, 14) if k < Kind.TRUCK else Vector2(42, 16)
+		if k >= Kind.RED:
+			half[i] = Vector2(5.8, 5.8) if k <= Kind.ACID else Vector2(22, 5)
+		if k == Kind.BAGS:
+			half[i] = Vector2(12, 12)
+		if k == Kind.WOOD:
+			half[i] = Vector2(16, 5)
+		high[i] = 1 if k <= Kind.TRUCK or k == Kind.JERSEY or k == Kind.FENCE else 0
+		round_shape[i] = 1 if k in [Kind.RED, Kind.ACID, Kind.BAGS] else 0
+		hp[i] = 120.0 if k <= Kind.TRUCK else 12.0
+	grid_w = ceili(rect.size.x / CELL)
+	grid_h = ceili(rect.size.y / CELL)
+	var n := grid_w * grid_h
+	near_head.resize(n)
+	blocked.resize(n)
+	flow.resize(n)
+	_next_flow.resize(n)
+	_distance.resize(n)
+	_queue.resize(n)
+	_los_stamp.resize(n)
+	_los_clear.resize(n)
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_nav_cd = 0.0
+	rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func cell_at(p: Vector2) -> int:
+	return clampi(int((p.x - arena.position.x) / CELL), 0, grid_w - 1) + clampi(int((p.y - arena.position.y) / CELL), 0, grid_h - 1) * grid_w
+
+
+func cell_center(c: int) -> Vector2:
+	return arena.position + Vector2(float(c % grid_w) + 0.5, float(c / grid_w) + 0.5) * CELL
+
+
+func rebuild_grid() -> void:
+	near_head.fill(-1)
+	blocked.fill(0)
+	_link_obj.clear()
+	_link_next.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var a := axis[i].abs()
+		var extent := a * half[i].x + Vector2(a.y, a.x) * half[i].y + Vector2.ONE * 34.0
+		var lo := Vector2i((pos[i] - extent - arena.position) / CELL).max(Vector2i.ZERO)
+		var hi := Vector2i((pos[i] + extent - arena.position) / CELL).min(Vector2i(grid_w - 1, grid_h - 1))
+		for y in range(lo.y, hi.y + 1):
+			for x in range(lo.x, hi.x + 1):
+				var c := x + y * grid_w
+				_link_obj.append(i)
+				_link_next.append(near_head[c])
+				near_head[c] = _link_obj.size() - 1
+				# Запас для элитки и диагонали клетки: поток не срезает углы.
+				if _overlaps(i, cell_center(c), 18.9):
+					blocked[c] = 1
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_los_version += 1
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _local(i: int, p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var rel := p - pos[i]
+	var a := axis[i]
+	return Vector2(rel.dot(a), rel.dot(a.orthogonal()))
+
+
+func _overlaps(i: int, p: Vector2, r: float) -> bool:
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		return pos[i].distance_squared_to(p) < (half[i].x + r) * (half[i].x + r)
+	var q := _local(i, p).abs() - half[i]
+	return q.max(Vector2.ZERO).length_squared() < r * r
+
+
+func contains(p: Vector2, r := 0.1) -> bool:
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		if state[i] != State.GONE and _overlaps(i, p, r):
+			return true
+		link = _link_next[link]
+	return false
+
+
+## Узкая фаза только в занятых окрестностях; повтор нужен в стыке двух блоков.
+func resolve(p: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	for pass_index in 4:
+		var changed := false
+		var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if state[i] == State.GONE:
+				continue
+			var q := _local(i, p)
+			if round_shape[i] == 1:
+				var distance := q.length()
+				var reach := half[i].x + r + 0.02
+				if distance >= reach:
+					continue
+				q = q / distance * reach if distance > 0.0001 else Vector2(reach, 0)
+			else:
+				var closest := q.clamp(-half[i], half[i])
+				var away := q - closest
+				var d2 := away.length_squared()
+				if d2 >= (r + 0.02) * (r + 0.02):
+					continue
+				if d2 > 0.000001:
+					q = closest + away * ((r + 0.02) / sqrt(d2))
+				else:
+					var depth := half[i] - q.abs()
+					if depth.x < depth.y:
+						q.x = (half[i].x + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.x >= 0 else -1.0)
+					else:
+						q.y = (half[i].y + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.y >= 0 else -1.0)
+			p = pos[i] + axis[i] * q.x + axis[i].orthogonal() * q.y
+			changed = true
+		if not changed:
+			break
+	return p
+
+
+## Подшаги исключают туннелирование рывка, тарана и сильного отброса.
+func move_actor(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / 4.0))
+	var step := (to - from) / float(steps)
+	var p := from
+	for j in steps:
+		p = resolve(p + step, r)
+	return p
+
+
+func free_point(p: Vector2, r := 8.0) -> Vector2:
+	p = p.clamp(arena.position + Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0), arena.end - Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0))
+	if not contains(p, r):
+		return p
+	var c := Vector2i((p - arena.position) / CELL)
+	for ring in 32:
+		for dy in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+			for dx in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+				if absi(dx) != ring and absi(dy) != ring:
+					continue
+				var q := c + Vector2i(dx, dy)
+				if q.x < 1 or q.y < 1 or q.x >= grid_w - 1 or q.y >= grid_h - 1:
+					continue
+				var at := cell_center(q.x + q.y * grid_w)
+				if not contains(at, r):
+					return at
+	return arena.get_center()
+
+
+## Сегмент против OBB/круга. Возвращает долю луча или INF.
+func _segment(i: int, from: Vector2, to: Vector2, radius: float) -> float:
+	var p := _local(i, from)
+	var v := _local(i, to) - p
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		var rr := half[i].x + radius
+		var a := v.length_squared()
+		var b := p.dot(v)
+		var c := p.length_squared() - rr * rr
+		if c <= 0.0:
+			return 0.0
+		var discriminant := b * b - a * c
+		if a <= 0.000001 or discriminant < 0.0:
+			return INF
+		var t := (-b - sqrt(discriminant)) / a
+		return t if t >= 0.0 and t <= 1.0 else INF
+	var extent := half[i] + Vector2.ONE * radius
+	var low := 0.0
+	var upper := 1.0
+	for dim in 2:
+		if absf(v[dim]) < 0.000001:
+			if absf(p[dim]) > extent[dim]:
+				return INF
+		else:
+			var a := (-extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			var b := (extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			low = maxf(low, minf(a, b))
+			upper = minf(upper, maxf(a, b))
+			if low > upper:
+				return INF
+	return low
+
+
+## Для коротких пуль достаточно бакета середины; длинные лучи проходят сетку.
+func ray_hit(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, only_high := false, radius := 1.0, ignore := -1) -> int:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / CELL))
+	var best := -1
+	var best_t := INF
+	var previous := -1
+	for step_index in steps + 1:
+		var c := cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(step_index) / float(steps)))
+		if c == previous:
+			continue
+		previous = c
+		var link := near_head[c]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if i == ignore or state[i] == State.GONE or (only_high and high[i] == 0):
+				continue
+			if not only_high and high[i] == 0 and kind[i] != Kind.RED and kind[i] != Kind.ACID:
+				continue
+			var t := _segment(i, from, to, radius)
+			if t < best_t:
+				best_t = t
+				best = i
+	return best
+
+
+func line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	return ray_hit(from, to, true, 0.0) == -1
+
+
+func steering(p: Vector2, direct: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	if not _flow_ready:
+		return direct
+	var c := cell_at(p)
+	if _los_stamp[c] != _los_version:
+		_los_stamp[c] = _los_version
+		_los_clear[c] = 1 if _nav_line_clear(cell_center(c), _flow_target) else 0
+	if _los_clear[c] == 1:
+		return direct
+	var direction := flow[c]
+	if direction == Vector2.ZERO:
+		# Агент мог быть растолкнут в запас сетки: берёт ближайшую свободную клетку.
+		var best := INF
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next >= 0 and next < blocked.size() and blocked[next] == 0 and _distance[next] < best:
+				best = _distance[next]
+				direction = (cell_center(next) - p).normalized()
+	return direction.normalized() if direction != Vector2.ZERO else direct
+
+
+func _nav_line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / (CELL * 0.65)))
+	for j in steps + 1:
+		if blocked[cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(j) / float(steps)))] != 0:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func navigation_step(delta: float, target: Vector2) -> void:
+	var start := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_nav_cd -= delta
+	var c := cell_at(free_point(target, 19.0))
+	if not _building and _nav_cd <= 0.0 and c != _target_cell:
+		_target_cell = c
+		_flow_target = cell_center(c)
+		_nav_cd = 0.2
+		_distance.fill(NO_PATH)
+		_next_flow.fill(Vector2.ZERO)
+		_distance[c] = 0
+		_queue[0] = c
+		_qread = 0
+		_qwrite = 1
+		_building = true
+	if _building:
+		var end := mini(_qread + FLOW_BUDGET, _qwrite)
+		# Срез бюджета расширяется вместе с FIFO, но не больше FLOW_BUDGET.
+		end = _qread + FLOW_BUDGET
+		while _qread < _qwrite and _qread < end:
+			var at := _queue[_qread]
+			_qread += 1
+			var x := at % grid_w
+			for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+				var next := at + offset
+				if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and x == 0) or (offset == 1 and x == grid_w - 1):
+					continue
+				if blocked[next] != 0:
+					continue
+				if _distance[next] == _distance[at] + 1:
+					var direction := Vector2(-offset, 0) if absi(offset) == 1 else Vector2(0, -signi(offset))
+					if _next_flow[next].dot(direction) >= 0.0:
+						_next_flow[next] += direction
+				if _distance[next] != NO_PATH:
+					continue
+				_distance[next] = _distance[at] + 1
+				_next_flow[next] = Vector2(-offset, 0) if absi(offset) == 1 else Vector2(0, -signi(offset))
+				_queue[_qwrite] = next
+				_qwrite += 1
+		if _qread == _qwrite:
+			_building = false
+			_flow_ready = true
+			_los_version += 1
+			nav_completed += 1
+			var previous := flow
+			flow = _next_flow
+			_next_flow = previous
+	nav_worst_usec = maxi(nav_worst_usec, Time.get_ticks_usec() - start)
+
+
+func connected() -> bool:
+	return unreachable_cell() == -1
+
+
+func unreachable_cell() -> int:
+	# Независимый flood-fill для проверки профиля, без изменения активного поля.
+	var seen := PackedByteArray()
+	seen.resize(blocked.size())
+	var todo := PackedInt32Array([cell_at(arena.get_center())])
+	seen[todo[0]] = 1
+	var head := 0
+	while head < todo.size():
+		var c := todo[head]
+		head += 1
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and c % grid_w == 0) or (offset == 1 and c % grid_w == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if blocked[next] == 0 and seen[next] == 0:
+				seen[next] = 1
+				todo.append(next)
+	for c in blocked.size():
+		if blocked[c] == 0 and seen[c] == 0:
+			return c
+	return -1
+
+
+func damage(i: int, amount: float, fire := false) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= count or kind[i] > Kind.ACID or state[i] >= State.BURNING:
+		return
+	hp[i] -= amount
+	if hp[i] <= 60.0:
+		if state[i] == State.INTACT and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			_smoking.append(i)
+		state[i] = State.DAMAGED
+	if hp[i] <= 0.0 or (fire and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK):
+		if kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			var smoking_index := _smoking.find(i)
+			if smoking_index >= 0:
+				_smoking.remove_at(smoking_index)
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			burn[i] = 4.0 + float(i % 3)
+			_burning.append(i)
+		else:
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func blast(at: Vector2, radius: float, amount: float) -> void:
+	for i in count:
+		if state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var d2 := pos[i].distance_squared_to(at)
+		if d2 > (radius + half[i].x) * (radius + half[i].x):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES:
+			var away := (pos[i] - at).normalized()
+			pos[i] += away * 12.0
+			rotation_angle[i] += 0.7
+		elif kind[i] <= Kind.ACID:
+			damage(i, amount * (1.0 - 0.5 * minf(sqrt(d2) / radius, 1.0)), amount >= 100.0)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func charge(at: Vector2, radius: float) -> bool:
+	var stopped := false
+	var dirty := false
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(at)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		link = _link_next[link]
+		if state[i] == State.GONE or not _overlaps(i, at, radius):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] == Kind.BAGS or kind[i] == Kind.WOOD:
+			state[i] = State.GONE
+			dirty = true
+		else:
+			damage(i, 180.0, true)
+			stopped = true
+	if dirty:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	return stopped
+
+
+## Кровь выбирает заранее обрезанную по альфе ступень того же атласа.
+func splatter(at: Vector2, _dir := Vector2.ZERO, _death := 0, _facing := 0.0, _variant := 0) -> void:
+	var changed := false
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE or blood[i] >= 3:
+			continue
+		if _overlaps(i, at, 42.0):
+			blood[i] += 1
+			blood_events += 1
+			changed = true
+	if changed:
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if player:
+		navigation_step(delta, player.global_position)
+	_fire_tick -= delta
+	var fire_tick := _fire_tick <= 0.0
+	if fire_tick:
+		_fire_tick = 0.25
+	for n in range(_burning.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var i := _burning[n]
+		burn[i] -= delta
+		if burn[i] <= 0.0:
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+			_burning.remove_at(n)
+		elif fire_tick and horde:
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], half[i].x + 18.0):
+				if _overlaps(i, horde.pos[j], 18.0):
+					horde.ignite(j, 6.0, 2.0)
+	# Снимок FIFO: цепь не рекурсивна, максимум четыре детонации за тик.
+	var n := mini(4, _blast_queue.size())
+	for j in n:
+		var i := _blast_queue[0]
+		_blast_queue.remove_at(0)
+		_detonate(i)
+
+
+func _detonate(i: int) -> void:
+	var car := kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK
+	state[i] = State.WRECK if car else State.GONE
+	detonations += 1
+	if kind[i] == Kind.ACID:
+		if hazards:
+			hazards.acid_pool(pos[i], 32.0, 8.0, 6.0)
+	else:
+		var radius := CAR_RADIUS if car else BARREL_RADIUS
+		var amount := CAR_DAMAGE if car else BARREL_DAMAGE
+		if explosions:
+			explosions.spawn(pos[i], radius, Explosions.Kind.CAR if car else Explosions.Kind.GRENADE)
+		if sfx:
+			sfx.play("explosions/grenade", pos[i], -1.0, 0.02)
+		if horde:
+			var previous := horde.death_override
+			horde.death_override = Gore.Death.GIBS
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], radius):
+				var offset := horde.pos[j] - pos[i]
+				var falloff := 1.0 - 0.5 * minf(offset.length() / radius, 1.0)
+				horde.damage(j, amount * falloff, offset.normalized(), 210.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.STANDARD, false, horde.pos[j], true)
+			horde.death_override = previous
+		if player and player.global_position.distance_squared_to(pos[i]) < radius * radius:
+			player.take_damage(amount)
+		blast(pos[i], radius, amount * 3.0)
+		splatter(pos[i])
+	if not car:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_visual_tick += delta
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self)
+	var cell := Vector2i(view.position / 48.0)
+	if cell != _view_cell or ((not _burning.is_empty() or not _smoking.is_empty()) and _visual_tick >= 0.083):
+		_view_cell = cell
+		_visual_tick = 0.0
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _tile(i: int) -> int:
+	var k := kind[i]
+	if k <= Kind.TRUCK:
+		return k * 4 + mini(state[i], 3)
+	if k <= Kind.ACID:
+		return 20 + (k - Kind.RED) * 2 + (1 if state[i] == State.DAMAGED else 0)
+	return 24 + k - Kind.JERSEY
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if _atlas == null:
+		return
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self, 130.0)
+	# Мусор в том же пакете, перед высокими объектами.
+	for layer in 2:
+		for i in count:
+			if state[i] == State.GONE or not view.has_point(pos[i]) or (kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES) != (layer == 0):
+				continue
+			var tile := _tile(i) + int(blood[i]) * TILES
+			var source := Rect2(Vector2(tile % 8, tile / 8) * ART_CELL, ART_CELL)
+			draw_set_transform(pos[i], rotation_angle[i], Vector2.ONE * PixelArt.ART_SCALE)
+			draw_texture_rect_region(_atlas, Rect2(-ART_CELL * 0.5, ART_CELL), source)
+	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
+	for i in _smoking:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 180 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 20.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-14, -30), Vector2(28, 32)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.55, 0.52, 0.45))
+	for i in _burning:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 80 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 18.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-24, -50), Vector2(48, 52)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.54, 0.51, 0.65))
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_fire, Rect2(at - Vector2(16, 30), Vector2(32, 36)), Rect2((frame + 2) * 144, (i % 3) * 144, 144, 144))

+"""Один контролируемый запуск. Оконные и perf-прогоны всегда берут общий lock."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import os

+        path.write_bytes(source)
+command = [GODOT]

+if mode == 'import':
+    command += ['--import']
+else:
+    command += ['--', *args]
+if mode == 'window':
+    command = ['C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.exe', LOCK, *command]
+print('RUN', label, ' '.join(command), flush=True)
+start = time.monotonic()
+try:
+    with (logs / ('o1_' + label + '.log')).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as log:

+        try:
+            code = process.wait(timeout=850 if mode == 'window' else 300)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:

+    print('\n'.join(interesting[-60:]), flush=True)

+class_name ArenaLayout
+extends RefCounted
+## Профиль — данные для O2; локальный RNG не меняет случайность боя.
+
+const QUARANTINE := {"name": "quarantine", "size": Vector2(2560, 1440),
+	"cars": 32, "barrels": 20, "checkpoints": 10, "litter": 320,
+	"vehicles": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "roads": [0.5, 0.5], "safe_radius": 200.0}
+
+
+static func generate(layout_seed: int, profile: Dictionary) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = layout_seed
+	var size: Vector2 = profile.get("size", Vector2(2560, 1440))
+	var center := size * 0.5
+	var safe: float = profile.get("safe_radius", 200.0)
+	var roads: Array = profile.get("roads", [0.5, 0.5])
+	var vehicles: Array = profile.get("vehicles", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var occupied := PackedVector2Array()
+	# Машины в двух полосах двух дорог; отдельные развёрнуты после аварии.
+	for i in int(profile.get("cars", 32)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var horizontal := i % 2 == 0
+			var lane := -65.0 if i % 4 < 2 else 65.0
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(120, size.x - 120), size.y * float(roads[1]) + lane)
+			if not horizontal:
+				p = Vector2(size.x * float(roads[0]) + lane, rng.randf_range(110, size.y - 110))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe, 104.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := (0.0 if horizontal else PI * 0.5) + rng.randf_range(-0.17, 0.17)
+			if i % 9 == 0:
+				angle += 0.5
+			result.append({"kind": int(vehicles[i % vehicles.size()]), "pos": p, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	# Открытые блокпосты: линии не соединяются в замкнутый периметр.
+	for i in int(profile.get("checkpoints", 10)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(100, size.x - 100), rng.randf_range(100, size.y - 100))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe + 45.0, 120.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := float(i % 2) * PI * 0.5
+			for j in 3:
+				var at := p + Vector2(float(j - 1) * 49.0, 0).rotated(angle)
+				result.append({"kind": 7 if j < 2 else (8 if i % 2 == 0 else 10), "pos": at, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	for i in int(profile.get("barrels", 20)):
+		var at: Vector2 = result[i % mini(32, result.size())]["pos"]
+		var p := at + Vector2(0, 51.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -51.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 5 if i % 3 != 0 else 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	for i in 12:
+		var p := Vector2(170.0 + float(i % 6) * 430.0, 60.0 if i < 6 else size.y - 60.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 9, "pos": p, "angle": 0.0})
+	for i in int(profile.get("litter", 320)):
+		var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(30, size.x - 30), rng.randf_range(30, size.y - 30))
+		result.append({"kind": 11 + i % 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	# Проверяем именно сетку с запасом элитки, которую затем использует орда.
+	var probe := Obstacles.new()
+	for attempt in 40:
+		probe.setup(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), result)
+		var unreachable := probe.unreachable_cell()
+		if unreachable == -1:
+			break
+		var at := probe.cell_center(unreachable)
+		var nearest := -1
+		var distance := INF
+		for i in result.size():
+			if int(result[i]["kind"]) >= 11:
+				continue
+			var d := Vector2(result[i]["pos"]).distance_squared_to(at)
+			if d < distance:
+				nearest = i
+				distance = d
+		if nearest < 0:
+			break
+		var p := Vector2(result[nearest]["pos"]) + Vector2(90, 75).rotated(float(attempt) * 2.4)
+		p = p.clamp(Vector2(95, 95), size - Vector2(95, 95))
+		if p.distance_to(center) < safe + 55.0:
+			p = center + (p - center).normalized() * (safe + 90.0)
+		result[nearest]["pos"] = p
+	probe.free()
+	return result
+
+
+static func _available(p: Vector2, occupied: PackedVector2Array, center: Vector2, safe: float, gap: float) -> bool:
+	if p.distance_squared_to(center) < (safe + 55.0) * (safe + 55.0):
+		return false
+	for q in occupied:
+		if p.distance_squared_to(q) < gap * gap:
+			return false
+	return true

+func scorch(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, scale_factor: float) -> void:
+	var stamp_data := [tex, pos, rot, scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE]
+	if _scorches.size() < 256:
+		_scorches.append(stamp_data)
+	else:
+		_scorches[_scorch_cursor] = stamp_data
+		_scorch_cursor = (_scorch_cursor + 1) % 256
+	_scorch_layer.queue_redraw()
+

+func _draw_scorches() -> void:

+func _ready() -> void:
+	_atlas = PixelArt.tex("obst_atlas")

+func setup(rect: Rect2, layout: Array[Dictionary]) -> void:
+	arena = rect
+	count = layout.size()
+	pos.resize(count)
+	half.resize(count)
+	axis.resize(count)
+	rotation_angle.resize(count)
+	kind.resize(count)
+	state.resize(count)
+	hp.resize(count)
+	burn.resize(count)
+	blood.resize(count)
+	high.resize(count)
+	round_shape.resize(count)
+	_burning.clear()
+	_smoking.clear()
+	_blast_queue.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		kind[i] = int(layout[i]["kind"])
+		pos[i] = layout[i]["pos"]
+		rotation_angle[i] = float(layout[i].get("angle", 0.0))
+		axis[i] = Vector2.from_angle(rotation_angle[i])
+		state[i] = State.INTACT
+		blood[i] = 0
+		burn[i] = 0.0
+		var k := kind[i]
+		half[i] = Vector2(32, 14) if k < Kind.TRUCK else Vector2(42, 16)
+		if k >= Kind.RED:
+			half[i] = Vector2(5.8, 5.8) if k <= Kind.ACID else Vector2(22, 5)
+		if k == Kind.BAGS:
+			half[i] = Vector2(12, 12)
+		if k == Kind.WOOD:
+			half[i] = Vector2(16, 5)
+		high[i] = 1 if k <= Kind.TRUCK or k == Kind.JERSEY or k == Kind.FENCE else 0
+		round_shape[i] = 1 if k in [Kind.RED, Kind.ACID, Kind.BAGS] else 0
+		hp[i] = 120.0 if k <= Kind.TRUCK else 12.0
+	grid_w = ceili(rect.size.x / CELL)
+	grid_h = ceili(rect.size.y / CELL)
+	var n := grid_w * grid_h
+	near_head.resize(n)
+	blocked.resize(n)
+	flow.resize(n)
+	_next_flow.resize(n)
+	_distance.resize(n)
+	_queue.resize(n)
+	_los_stamp.resize(n)
+	_los_clear.resize(n)
+	_adjacency.resize(n * 4)
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_nav_cd = 0.0
+	rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func cell_at(p: Vector2) -> int:
+	return clampi(int((p.x - arena.position.x) / CELL), 0, grid_w - 1) + clampi(int((p.y - arena.position.y) / CELL), 0, grid_h - 1) * grid_w
+
+
+func cell_center(c: int) -> Vector2:
+	return arena.position + Vector2(float(c % grid_w) + 0.5, float(c / grid_w) + 0.5) * CELL
+
+
+func rebuild_grid() -> void:
+	near_head.fill(-1)
+	blocked.fill(0)
+	_link_obj.clear()
+	_link_next.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var a := axis[i].abs()
+		var extent := a * half[i].x + Vector2(a.y, a.x) * half[i].y + Vector2.ONE * 34.0
+		var lo := Vector2i((pos[i] - extent - arena.position) / CELL).max(Vector2i.ZERO)
+		var hi := Vector2i((pos[i] + extent - arena.position) / CELL).min(Vector2i(grid_w - 1, grid_h - 1))
+		for y in range(lo.y, hi.y + 1):
+			for x in range(lo.x, hi.x + 1):
+				var c := x + y * grid_w
+				_link_obj.append(i)
+				_link_next.append(near_head[c])
+				near_head[c] = _link_obj.size() - 1
+				# Запас для элитки и диагонали клетки: поток не срезает углы.
+				if _overlaps(i, cell_center(c), 18.9):
+					blocked[c] = 1
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_los_version += 1
+	# Связи неизменны между разрушениями: горячий BFS не считает границы и координаты.
+	_adjacency.fill(-1)
+	for c in blocked.size():
+		if blocked[c] != 0:
+			continue
+		var x := c % grid_w
+		for direction_index in 4:
+			var offset: int = [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w][direction_index]
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (direction_index == 0 and x == 0) or (direction_index == 1 and x == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if blocked[next] == 0:
+				_adjacency[c * 4 + direction_index] = next
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _local(i: int, p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var rel := p - pos[i]
+	var a := axis[i]
+	return Vector2(rel.dot(a), rel.dot(a.orthogonal()))
+
+
+func _overlaps(i: int, p: Vector2, r: float) -> bool:
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		return pos[i].distance_squared_to(p) < (half[i].x + r) * (half[i].x + r)
+	var q := _local(i, p).abs() - half[i]
+	return q.max(Vector2.ZERO).length_squared() < r * r
+
+
+func contains(p: Vector2, r := 0.1) -> bool:
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		if state[i] != State.GONE and _overlaps(i, p, r):
+			return true
+		link = _link_next[link]
+	return false
+
+
+## Узкая фаза только в занятых окрестностях; повтор нужен в стыке двух блоков.
+func resolve(p: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	for pass_index in 4:
+		var changed := false
+		var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if state[i] == State.GONE:
+				continue
+			var q := _local(i, p)
+			if round_shape[i] == 1:
+				var distance := q.length()
+				var reach := half[i].x + r + 0.02
+				if distance >= reach:
+					continue
+				q = q / distance * reach if distance > 0.0001 else Vector2(reach, 0)
+			else:
+				var closest := q.clamp(-half[i], half[i])
+				var away := q - closest
+				var d2 := away.length_squared()
+				if d2 >= (r + 0.02) * (r + 0.02):
+					continue
+				if d2 > 0.000001:
+					q = closest + away * ((r + 0.02) / sqrt(d2))
+				else:
+					var depth := half[i] - q.abs()
+					if depth.x < depth.y:
+						q.x = (half[i].x + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.x >= 0 else -1.0)
+					else:
+						q.y = (half[i].y + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.y >= 0 else -1.0)
+			p = pos[i] + axis[i] * q.x + axis[i].orthogonal() * q.y
+			changed = true
+		if not changed:
+			break
+	return p
+
+
+## Подшаги исключают туннелирование рывка, тарана и сильного отброса.
+func move_actor(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / 4.0))
+	var step := (to - from) / float(steps)
+	var p := from
+	for j in steps:
+		p = resolve(p + step, r)
+	return p
+
+
+func free_point(p: Vector2, r := 8.0) -> Vector2:
+	p = p.clamp(arena.position + Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0), arena.end - Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0))
+	if not contains(p, r):
+		return p
+	var c := Vector2i((p - arena.position) / CELL)
+	for ring in 32:
+		for dy in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+			for dx in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+				if absi(dx) != ring and absi(dy) != ring:
+					continue
+				var q := c + Vector2i(dx, dy)
+				if q.x < 1 or q.y < 1 or q.x >= grid_w - 1 or q.y >= grid_h - 1:
+					continue
+				var at := cell_center(q.x + q.y * grid_w)
+				if not contains(at, r):
+					return at
+	return arena.get_center()
+
+
+## Сегмент против OBB/круга. Возвращает долю луча или INF.
+func _segment(i: int, from: Vector2, to: Vector2, radius: float) -> float:
+	var p := _local(i, from)
+	var v := _local(i, to) - p
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		var rr := half[i].x + radius
+		var a := v.length_squared()
+		var b := p.dot(v)
+		var c := p.length_squared() - rr * rr
+		if c <= 0.0:
+			return 0.0
+		var discriminant := b * b - a * c
+		if a <= 0.000001 or discriminant < 0.0:
+			return INF
+		var t := (-b - sqrt(discriminant)) / a
+		return t if t >= 0.0 and t <= 1.0 else INF
+	var extent := half[i] + Vector2.ONE * radius
+	var low := 0.0
+	var upper := 1.0
+	for dim in 2:
+		if absf(v[dim]) < 0.000001:
+			if absf(p[dim]) > extent[dim]:
+				return INF
+		else:
+			var a := (-extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			var b := (extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			low = maxf(low, minf(a, b))
+			upper = minf(upper, maxf(a, b))
+			if low > upper:
+				return INF
+	return low
+
+
+## Для коротких пуль достаточно бакета середины; длинные лучи проходят сетку.
+func ray_hit(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, only_high := false, radius := 1.0, ignore := -1) -> int:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / CELL))
+	var best := -1
+	var best_t := INF
+	var previous := -1
+	for step_index in steps + 1:
+		var c := cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(step_index) / float(steps)))
+		if c == previous:
+			continue
+		previous = c
+		var link := near_head[c]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if i == ignore or state[i] == State.GONE or (only_high and high[i] == 0):
+				continue
+			if not only_high and high[i] == 0 and kind[i] != Kind.RED and kind[i] != Kind.ACID:
+				continue
+			var t := _segment(i, from, to, radius)
+			if t < best_t:
+				best_t = t
+				best = i
+	return best
+
+
+func line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	return ray_hit(from, to, true, 0.0) == -1
+
+
+func steering(p: Vector2, direct: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	if not _flow_ready:
+		return direct
+	var c := cell_at(p)
+	if _los_stamp[c] != _los_version:
+		_los_stamp[c] = _los_version
+		_los_clear[c] = 1 if _nav_line_clear(cell_center(c), _flow_target) else 0
+	if _los_clear[c] == 1:
+		return direct
+	var direction := flow[c]
+	if direction == Vector2.ZERO:
+		# Агент мог быть растолкнут в запас сетки: берёт ближайшую свободную клетку.
+		var best := INF
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next >= 0 and next < blocked.size() and blocked[next] == 0 and _distance[next] < best:
+				best = _distance[next]
+				direction = (cell_center(next) - p).normalized()
+	return direction.normalized() if direction != Vector2.ZERO else direct
+
+
+func _nav_line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / (CELL * 0.65)))
+	for j in steps + 1:
+		if blocked[cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(j) / float(steps)))] != 0:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func navigation_step(delta: float, target: Vector2) -> void:
+	var start := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_nav_cd -= delta
+	var c := cell_at(free_point(target, 19.0))
+	if not _building and _nav_cd <= 0.0 and c != _target_cell:
+		_target_cell = c
+		_flow_target = cell_center(c)
+		_nav_cd = 0.2
+		_distance.fill(NO_PATH)
+		_next_flow.fill(Vector2.ZERO)
+		_distance[c] = 0
+		_queue[0] = c
+		_qread = 0
+		_qwrite = 1
+		_building = true
+	if _building:
+		var end := _qread + FLOW_BUDGET
+		while _qread < _qwrite and _qread < end:
+			var at := _queue[_qread]
+			_qread += 1
+			for direction_index in 4:
+				var next := _adjacency[at * 4 + direction_index]
+				if next < 0 or _distance[next] != NO_PATH:
+					continue
+				_distance[next] = _distance[at] + 1
+				_next_flow[next] = _directions[direction_index]
+				_queue[_qwrite] = next
+				_qwrite += 1
+		if _qread == _qwrite:
+			_building = false
+			_flow_ready = true
+			_los_version += 1
+			nav_completed += 1
+			var previous := flow
+			flow = _next_flow
+			_next_flow = previous
+	nav_worst_usec = maxi(nav_worst_usec, Time.get_ticks_usec() - start)
+
+
+func connected() -> bool:
+	return unreachable_cell() == -1
+
+
+func unreachable_cell() -> int:
+	# Независимый flood-fill для проверки профиля, без изменения активного поля.
+	var seen := PackedByteArray()
+	seen.resize(blocked.size())
+	var todo := PackedInt32Array([cell_at(arena.get_center())])
+	seen[todo[0]] = 1
+	var head := 0
+	while head < todo.size():
+		var c := todo[head]
+		head += 1
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and c % grid_w == 0) or (offset == 1 and c % grid_w == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if blocked[next] == 0 and seen[next] == 0:
+				seen[next] = 1
+				todo.append(next)
+	for c in blocked.size():
+		if blocked[c] == 0 and seen[c] == 0:
+			return c
+	return -1
+
+
+func damage(i: int, amount: float, fire := false) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= count or kind[i] > Kind.ACID or state[i] >= State.BURNING:
+		return
+	hp[i] -= amount
+	if hp[i] <= 60.0:
+		if state[i] == State.INTACT and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			_smoking.append(i)
+		state[i] = State.DAMAGED
+	if hp[i] <= 0.0 or (fire and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK):
+		if kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			var smoking_index := _smoking.find(i)
+			if smoking_index >= 0:
+				_smoking.remove_at(smoking_index)
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			burn[i] = 4.0 + float(i % 3)
+			_burning.append(i)
+		else:
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func blast(at: Vector2, radius: float, amount: float) -> void:
+	for i in count:
+		if state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var d2 := pos[i].distance_squared_to(at)
+		if d2 > (radius + half[i].x) * (radius + half[i].x):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES:
+			var away := (pos[i] - at).normalized()
+			pos[i] += away * 12.0
+			rotation_angle[i] += 0.7
+		elif kind[i] <= Kind.ACID:
+			damage(i, amount * (1.0 - 0.5 * minf(sqrt(d2) / radius, 1.0)), amount >= 100.0)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func charge(at: Vector2, radius: float) -> bool:
+	var stopped := false
+	var dirty := false
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(at)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		link = _link_next[link]
+		if state[i] == State.GONE or not _overlaps(i, at, radius):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] == Kind.BAGS or kind[i] == Kind.WOOD:
+			state[i] = State.GONE
+			dirty = true
+		else:
+			damage(i, 180.0, true)
+			stopped = true
+	if dirty:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	return stopped
+
+
+## Кровь выбирает заранее обрезанную по альфе ступень того же атласа.
+func splatter(at: Vector2, _dir := Vector2.ZERO, _death := 0, _facing := 0.0, _variant := 0) -> void:
+	var changed := false
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE or blood[i] >= 3:
+			continue
+		if _overlaps(i, at, 42.0):
+			blood[i] += 1
+			blood_events += 1
+			changed = true
+	if changed:
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if player:
+		navigation_step(delta, player.global_position)
+	_fire_tick -= delta
+	var fire_tick := _fire_tick <= 0.0
+	if fire_tick:
+		_fire_tick = 0.25
+	for n in range(_burning.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var i := _burning[n]
+		burn[i] -= delta
+		if burn[i] <= 0.0:
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+			_burning.remove_at(n)
+		elif fire_tick and horde:
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], half[i].x + 18.0):
+				if _overlaps(i, horde.pos[j], 18.0):
+					horde.ignite(j, 6.0, 2.0)
+	# Снимок FIFO: цепь не рекурсивна, максимум четыре детонации за тик.
+	var n := mini(4, _blast_queue.size())
+	for j in n:
+		var i := _blast_queue[0]
+		_blast_queue.remove_at(0)
+		_detonate(i)
+
+
+func _detonate(i: int) -> void:
+	var car := kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK
+	state[i] = State.WRECK if car else State.GONE
+	detonations += 1
+	if kind[i] == Kind.ACID:
+		if hazards:
+			hazards.acid_pool(pos[i], 32.0, 8.0, 6.0)
+	else:
+		var radius := CAR_RADIUS if car else BARREL_RADIUS
+		var amount := CAR_DAMAGE if car else BARREL_DAMAGE
+		if explosions:
+			explosions.spawn(pos[i], radius, Explosions.Kind.CAR if car else Explosions.Kind.GRENADE)
+		if sfx:
+			sfx.play("explosions/grenade", pos[i], -1.0, 0.02)
+		if horde:
+			var previous := horde.death_override
+			horde.death_override = Gore.Death.GIBS
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], radius):
+				var offset := horde.pos[j] - pos[i]
+				var falloff := 1.0 - 0.5 * minf(offset.length() / radius, 1.0)
+				horde.damage(j, amount * falloff, offset.normalized(), 210.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.STANDARD, false, horde.pos[j], true)
+			horde.death_override = previous
+		if player and player.global_position.distance_squared_to(pos[i]) < radius * radius:
+			player.take_damage(amount)
+		blast(pos[i], radius, amount * 3.0)
+		splatter(pos[i])
+	if not car:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_visual_tick += delta
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self)
+	var cell := Vector2i(view.position / 48.0)
+	if cell != _view_cell or ((not _burning.is_empty() or not _smoking.is_empty()) and _visual_tick >= 0.083):
+		_view_cell = cell
+		_visual_tick = 0.0
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _tile(i: int) -> int:
+	var k := kind[i]
+	if k <= Kind.TRUCK:
+		return k * 4 + mini(state[i], 3)
+	if k <= Kind.ACID:
+		return 20 + (k - Kind.RED) * 2 + (1 if state[i] == State.DAMAGED else 0)
+	return 24 + k - Kind.JERSEY
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if _atlas == null:
+		return
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self, 130.0)
+	# Мусор в том же пакете, перед высокими объектами.
+	for layer in 2:
+		for i in count:
+			if state[i] == State.GONE or not view.has_point(pos[i]) or (kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES) != (layer == 0):
+				continue
+			var tile := _tile(i) + int(blood[i]) * TILES
+			var source := Rect2(Vector2(tile % 8, tile / 8) * ART_CELL, ART_CELL)
+			draw_set_transform(pos[i], rotation_angle[i], Vector2.ONE * PixelArt.ART_SCALE)
+			draw_texture_rect_region(_atlas, Rect2(-ART_CELL * 0.5, ART_CELL), source)
+	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
+	for i in _smoking:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 180 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 20.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-14, -30), Vector2(28, 32)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.55, 0.52, 0.45))
+	for i in _burning:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 80 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 18.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-24, -50), Vector2(48, 52)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.54, 0.51, 0.65))
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_fire, Rect2(at - Vector2(16, 30), Vector2(32, 36)), Rect2((frame + 2) * 144, (i % 3) * 144, 144, 144))

+def bloody(im, index, stage):
+    if not stage:
+        return im
+    rng = random.Random(8123 + index)
+    layer = Image.new("RGBA", im.size)
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
+    bounds = im.getbbox()
+    for _ in range(stage * 28):
+        xx, yy = rng.randrange(bounds[0],bounds[2]),rng.randrange(bounds[1],bounds[3])
+        rr = rng.randrange(1,6)
+        d.ellipse((xx-rr,yy-rr,xx+rr*2,yy+rr),fill=(89+rng.randrange(32),10,13,215))
+        if rr > 3:
+            d.line((xx,yy,xx+3,yy+10),fill=(75,8,11,180),width=2)
+    layer.putalpha(ImageChops.multiply(layer.getchannel("A"),im.getchannel("A")))
+    return Image.alpha_composite(im,layer)
+

+"""Один контролируемый запуск. Оконные и perf-прогоны всегда берут общий lock."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+GODOT = 'C:/Users/Dev/Desktop/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe'
+LOCK = 'C:/Users/Dev/Desktop/zera-assets/locks/godot_exclusive.sh'
+label, mode, *args = sys.argv[1:]
+logs = ROOT / 'design/tasks/reports'
+env = os.environ.copy()
+env['APPDATA'] = str(logs / 'o1_runtime')
+env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
+(logs / 'o1_runtime').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+original = {}
+if '--pre-e1b' in args:
+    args.remove('--pre-e1b')
+    for file in ('game.gd', 'weapons.gd', 'hazards.gd'):
+        path = ROOT / 'scripts' / file
+        original[path] = path.read_bytes()
+        source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:scripts/' + file], cwd=ROOT)
+        if file == 'game.gd':
+            source = source.replace(b'func _ready() -> void:\n', b'func _ready() -> void:\n\tseed(81073)\n', 1)
+        path.write_bytes(source)
+command = [GODOT]
+if mode == 'headless' or mode == 'import':
+    command += ['--headless']
+else:
+    command += ['--disable-vsync']
+command += ['--path', str(ROOT), '--log-file', str(logs / ('o1_' + label + '_engine.log'))]
+if mode == 'import':
+    command += ['--import']
+else:
+    command += ['--', *args]
+if mode == 'window':
+    command = ['C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.exe', LOCK, *command]
+print('RUN', label, ' '.join(command), flush=True)
+start = time.monotonic()
+try:
+    with (logs / ('o1_' + label + '.log')).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as log:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        try:
+            code = process.wait(timeout=850 if mode == 'window' else 300)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/PID', str(process.pid), '/T', '/F'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
+            code = 124
+    print('EXIT', label, code, 'seconds=%.2f' % (time.monotonic()-start), flush=True)
+    lines = (logs / ('o1_' + label + '.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines()
+    interesting = [line for line in lines if any(t in line for t in ('GODOT_EXCLUSIVE', 'BENCH', 'OBSTEST', 'SIM ', 'TEST ', 'TEST ok', 'FXTEST', 'BOSS ', 'ALARM ', 'ERROR:', 'WARNING:'))]
+    print('\n'.join(interesting[-60:]), flush=True)
+finally:
+    for path, source in original.items():
+        path.write_bytes(source)
+sys.exit(code)

+class_name ArenaLayout
+extends RefCounted
+## Профиль — данные для O2; локальный RNG не меняет случайность боя.
+
+const QUARANTINE := {"name": "quarantine", "size": Vector2(2560, 1440),
+	"cars": 32, "barrels": 20, "checkpoints": 10, "litter": 320,
+	"vehicles": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "roads": [0.5, 0.5], "safe_radius": 200.0}
+
+
+static func generate(layout_seed: int, profile: Dictionary) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = layout_seed
+	var size: Vector2 = profile.get("size", Vector2(2560, 1440))
+	var center := size * 0.5
+	var safe: float = profile.get("safe_radius", 200.0)
+	var roads: Array = profile.get("roads", [0.5, 0.5])
+	var vehicles: Array = profile.get("vehicles", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var occupied := PackedVector2Array()
+	# Машины в двух полосах двух дорог; отдельные развёрнуты после аварии.
+	for i in int(profile.get("cars", 32)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var horizontal := i % 2 == 0
+			var lane := -65.0 if i % 4 < 2 else 65.0
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(120, size.x - 120), size.y * float(roads[1]) + lane)
+			if not horizontal:
+				p = Vector2(size.x * float(roads[0]) + lane, rng.randf_range(110, size.y - 110))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe, 104.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := (0.0 if horizontal else PI * 0.5) + rng.randf_range(-0.17, 0.17)
+			if i % 9 == 0:
+				angle += 0.5
+			result.append({"kind": int(vehicles[i % vehicles.size()]), "pos": p, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	# Открытые блокпосты: линии не соединяются в замкнутый периметр.
+	for i in int(profile.get("checkpoints", 10)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(100, size.x - 100), rng.randf_range(100, size.y - 100))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe + 45.0, 120.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := float(i % 2) * PI * 0.5
+			for j in 3:
+				var at := p + Vector2(float(j - 1) * 49.0, 0).rotated(angle)
+				result.append({"kind": 7 if j < 2 else (8 if i % 2 == 0 else 10), "pos": at, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	for i in int(profile.get("barrels", 20)):
+		var at: Vector2 = result[i % mini(32, result.size())]["pos"]
+		var p := at + Vector2(0, 51.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -51.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 5 if i % 3 != 0 else 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	for i in 12:
+		var p := Vector2(170.0 + float(i % 6) * 430.0, 60.0 if i < 6 else size.y - 60.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 9, "pos": p, "angle": 0.0})
+	for i in int(profile.get("litter", 320)):
+		var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(30, size.x - 30), rng.randf_range(30, size.y - 30))
+		result.append({"kind": 11 + i % 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	# Проверяем именно сетку с запасом элитки, которую затем использует орда.
+	var probe := Obstacles.new()
+	for attempt in 40:
+		probe.setup(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), result)
+		var unreachable := probe.unreachable_cell()
+		if unreachable == -1:
+			break
+		var at := probe.cell_center(unreachable)
+		var nearest := -1
+		var distance := INF
+		for i in result.size():
+			if int(result[i]["kind"]) >= 11:
+				continue
+			var d := Vector2(result[i]["pos"]).distance_squared_to(at)
+			if d < distance:
+				nearest = i
+				distance = d
+		if nearest < 0:
+			break
+		var p := Vector2(result[nearest]["pos"]) + Vector2(90, 75).rotated(float(attempt) * 2.4)
+		p = p.clamp(Vector2(95, 95), size - Vector2(95, 95))
+		if p.distance_to(center) < safe + 55.0:
+			p = center + (p - center).normalized() * (safe + 90.0)
+		result[nearest]["pos"] = p
+	probe.free()
+	return result
+
+
+static func _available(p: Vector2, occupied: PackedVector2Array, center: Vector2, safe: float, gap: float) -> bool:
+	if p.distance_squared_to(center) < (safe + 55.0) * (safe + 55.0):
+		return false
+	for q in occupied:
+		if p.distance_squared_to(q) < gap * gap:
+			return false
+	return true

+func scorch(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, scale_factor: float) -> void:
+	var stamp_data := [tex, pos, rot, scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE]
+	if _scorches.size() < 256:
+		_scorches.append(stamp_data)
+	else:
+		_scorches[_scorch_cursor] = stamp_data
+		_scorch_cursor = (_scorch_cursor + 1) % 256
+	_scorch_layer.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _draw_scorches() -> void:
+	# Три текстуры рисуются группами: старые подпалины не дробят пакет.

+class_name Obstacles
+extends Node2D
+## O1: общая сетка, packed-строки, ограниченная очередь детонаций и один атлас.

+enum Kind { SEDAN, HATCH, POLICE, JEEP, TRUCK, RED, ACID, JERSEY, BAGS, FENCE, WOOD, TIRES, RUBBISH, PAPER, BOARDS, GLASS, CONE }
+enum State { INTACT, DAMAGED, BURNING, WRECK, GONE }
+const CELL := 16.0
+const ART_CELL := Vector2(288, 144)
+const TILES := 34

+var pos := PackedVector2Array()
+var half := PackedVector2Array()
+var axis := PackedVector2Array()

+var kind := PackedByteArray()
+var state := PackedByteArray()
+var hp := PackedFloat32Array()

+var high := PackedByteArray()
+var round_shape := PackedByteArray()

+func _ready() -> void:
+	_atlas = PixelArt.tex("obst_atlas")
+	_fire = PixelArt.tex("fx_explosion_medium")
+	_smoke = PixelArt.tex("fx_smoke")
+	process_priority = -20
+	_rng.seed = 17081

+func setup(rect: Rect2, layout: Array[Dictionary]) -> void:
+	arena = rect
+	count = layout.size()
+	pos.resize(count)
+	half.resize(count)
+	axis.resize(count)
+	rotation_angle.resize(count)
+	kind.resize(count)
+	state.resize(count)
+	hp.resize(count)
+	burn.resize(count)
+	blood.resize(count)
+	high.resize(count)
+	round_shape.resize(count)
+	_burning.clear()
+	_smoking.clear()
+	_blast_queue.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		kind[i] = int(layout[i]["kind"])
+		pos[i] = layout[i]["pos"]
+		rotation_angle[i] = float(layout[i].get("angle", 0.0))
+		axis[i] = Vector2.from_angle(rotation_angle[i])
+		state[i] = State.INTACT
+		blood[i] = 0
+		burn[i] = 0.0
+		var k := kind[i]
+		half[i] = Vector2(32, 14) if k < Kind.TRUCK else Vector2(42, 16)
+		if k >= Kind.RED:
+			half[i] = Vector2(5.8, 5.8) if k <= Kind.ACID else Vector2(22, 5)
+		if k == Kind.BAGS:
+			half[i] = Vector2(12, 12)
+		if k == Kind.WOOD:
+			half[i] = Vector2(16, 5)
+		high[i] = 1 if k <= Kind.TRUCK or k == Kind.JERSEY or k == Kind.FENCE else 0
+		round_shape[i] = 1 if k in [Kind.RED, Kind.ACID, Kind.BAGS] else 0
+		hp[i] = 120.0 if k <= Kind.TRUCK else 12.0
+	grid_w = ceili(rect.size.x / CELL)
+	grid_h = ceili(rect.size.y / CELL)
+	var n := grid_w * grid_h
+	near_head.resize(n)
+	blocked.resize(n)
+	flow.resize(n)
+	_next_flow.resize(n)
+	_distance.resize(n)
+	_queue.resize(n)
+	_los_stamp.resize(n)
+	_los_clear.resize(n)
+	_adjacency.resize(n * 4)
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_nav_cd = 0.0
+	rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func cell_at(p: Vector2) -> int:
+	return clampi(int((p.x - arena.position.x) / CELL), 0, grid_w - 1) + clampi(int((p.y - arena.position.y) / CELL), 0, grid_h - 1) * grid_w
+
+
+func cell_center(c: int) -> Vector2:
+	return arena.position + Vector2(float(c % grid_w) + 0.5, float(c / grid_w) + 0.5) * CELL
+
+
+func rebuild_grid() -> void:
+	near_head.fill(-1)
+	blocked.fill(0)
+	_link_obj.clear()
+	_link_next.clear()
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var a := axis[i].abs()
+		var extent := a * half[i].x + Vector2(a.y, a.x) * half[i].y + Vector2.ONE * 34.0
+		var lo := Vector2i((pos[i] - extent - arena.position) / CELL).max(Vector2i.ZERO)
+		var hi := Vector2i((pos[i] + extent - arena.position) / CELL).min(Vector2i(grid_w - 1, grid_h - 1))
+		for y in range(lo.y, hi.y + 1):
+			for x in range(lo.x, hi.x + 1):
+				var c := x + y * grid_w
+				_link_obj.append(i)
+				_link_next.append(near_head[c])
+				near_head[c] = _link_obj.size() - 1
+				# Запас для элитки и диагонали клетки: поток не срезает углы.
+				if _overlaps(i, cell_center(c), 18.9):
+					blocked[c] = 1
+	_flow_ready = false
+	_building = false
+	_target_cell = -1
+	_los_version += 1
+	# Связи неизменны между разрушениями: горячий BFS не считает границы и координаты.
+	_adjacency.fill(-1)
+	for c in blocked.size():
+		if blocked[c] != 0:
+			continue
+		var x := c % grid_w
+		for direction_index in 4:
+			var offset: int = [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w][direction_index]
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (direction_index == 0 and x == 0) or (direction_index == 1 and x == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if blocked[next] == 0:
+				_adjacency[c * 4 + direction_index] = next
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _local(i: int, p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	var rel := p - pos[i]
+	var a := axis[i]
+	return Vector2(rel.dot(a), rel.dot(a.orthogonal()))
+
+
+func _overlaps(i: int, p: Vector2, r: float) -> bool:
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		return pos[i].distance_squared_to(p) < (half[i].x + r) * (half[i].x + r)
+	var q := _local(i, p).abs() - half[i]
+	return q.max(Vector2.ZERO).length_squared() < r * r
+
+
+func contains(p: Vector2, r := 0.1) -> bool:
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		if state[i] != State.GONE and _overlaps(i, p, r):
+			return true
+		link = _link_next[link]
+	return false
+
+
+## Узкая фаза только в занятых окрестностях; повтор нужен в стыке двух блоков.
+func resolve(p: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	for pass_index in 4:
+		var changed := false
+		var link := near_head[cell_at(p)]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if state[i] == State.GONE:
+				continue
+			var q := _local(i, p)
+			if round_shape[i] == 1:
+				var distance := q.length()
+				var reach := half[i].x + r + 0.02
+				if distance >= reach:
+					continue
+				q = q / distance * reach if distance > 0.0001 else Vector2(reach, 0)
+			else:
+				var closest := q.clamp(-half[i], half[i])
+				var away := q - closest
+				var d2 := away.length_squared()
+				if d2 >= (r + 0.02) * (r + 0.02):
+					continue
+				if d2 > 0.000001:
+					q = closest + away * ((r + 0.02) / sqrt(d2))
+				else:
+					var depth := half[i] - q.abs()
+					if depth.x < depth.y:
+						q.x = (half[i].x + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.x >= 0 else -1.0)
+					else:
+						q.y = (half[i].y + r + 0.02) * (1.0 if q.y >= 0 else -1.0)
+			p = pos[i] + axis[i] * q.x + axis[i].orthogonal() * q.y
+			changed = true
+		if not changed:
+			break
+	return p
+
+
+## Подшаги исключают туннелирование рывка, тарана и сильного отброса.
+func move_actor(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, r: float) -> Vector2:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / 4.0))
+	var step := (to - from) / float(steps)
+	var p := from
+	for j in steps:
+		p = resolve(p + step, r)
+	return p
+
+
+func free_point(p: Vector2, r := 8.0) -> Vector2:
+	p = p.clamp(arena.position + Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0), arena.end - Vector2.ONE * (r + 4.0))
+	if not contains(p, r):
+		return p
+	var c := Vector2i((p - arena.position) / CELL)
+	for ring in 32:
+		for dy in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+			for dx in range(-ring, ring + 1):
+				if absi(dx) != ring and absi(dy) != ring:
+					continue
+				var q := c + Vector2i(dx, dy)
+				if q.x < 1 or q.y < 1 or q.x >= grid_w - 1 or q.y >= grid_h - 1:
+					continue
+				var at := cell_center(q.x + q.y * grid_w)
+				if not contains(at, r):
+					return at
+	return arena.get_center()
+
+
+## Сегмент против OBB/круга. Возвращает долю луча или INF.
+func _segment(i: int, from: Vector2, to: Vector2, radius: float) -> float:
+	var p := _local(i, from)
+	var v := _local(i, to) - p
+	if round_shape[i] == 1:
+		var rr := half[i].x + radius
+		var a := v.length_squared()
+		var b := p.dot(v)
+		var c := p.length_squared() - rr * rr
+		if c <= 0.0:
+			return 0.0
+		var discriminant := b * b - a * c
+		if a <= 0.000001 or discriminant < 0.0:
+			return INF
+		var t := (-b - sqrt(discriminant)) / a
+		return t if t >= 0.0 and t <= 1.0 else INF
+	var extent := half[i] + Vector2.ONE * radius
+	var low := 0.0
+	var upper := 1.0
+	for dim in 2:
+		if absf(v[dim]) < 0.000001:
+			if absf(p[dim]) > extent[dim]:
+				return INF
+		else:
+			var a := (-extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			var b := (extent[dim] - p[dim]) / v[dim]
+			low = maxf(low, minf(a, b))
+			upper = minf(upper, maxf(a, b))
+			if low > upper:
+				return INF
+	return low
+
+
+## Для коротких пуль достаточно бакета середины; длинные лучи проходят сетку.
+func ray_hit(from: Vector2, to: Vector2, only_high := false, radius := 1.0, ignore := -1) -> int:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / CELL))
+	var best := -1
+	var best_t := INF
+	var previous := -1
+	for step_index in steps + 1:
+		var c := cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(step_index) / float(steps)))
+		if c == previous:
+			continue
+		previous = c
+		var link := near_head[c]
+		while link != -1:
+			var i := _link_obj[link]
+			link = _link_next[link]
+			if i == ignore or state[i] == State.GONE or (only_high and high[i] == 0):
+				continue
+			if not only_high and high[i] == 0 and kind[i] != Kind.RED and kind[i] != Kind.ACID:
+				continue
+			var t := _segment(i, from, to, radius)
+			if t < best_t:
+				best_t = t
+				best = i
+	return best
+
+
+func line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	return ray_hit(from, to, true, 0.0) == -1
+
+
+func steering(p: Vector2, direct: Vector2) -> Vector2:
+	if not _flow_ready:
+		return direct
+	var c := cell_at(p)
+	if _los_stamp[c] != _los_version:
+		_los_stamp[c] = _los_version
+		_los_clear[c] = 1 if _nav_line_clear(cell_center(c), _flow_target) else 0
+	if _los_clear[c] == 1:
+		return direct
+	var direction := flow[c]
+	if direction == Vector2.ZERO:
+		# Агент мог быть растолкнут в запас сетки: берёт ближайшую свободную клетку.
+		var best := INF
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next >= 0 and next < blocked.size() and blocked[next] == 0 and _distance[next] < best:
+				best = _distance[next]
+				direction = (cell_center(next) - p).normalized()
+	return direction.normalized() if direction != Vector2.ZERO else direct
+
+
+func _nav_line_clear(from: Vector2, to: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var steps := maxi(1, ceili(from.distance_to(to) / (CELL * 0.65)))
+	for j in steps + 1:
+		if blocked[cell_at(from.lerp(to, float(j) / float(steps)))] != 0:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func navigation_step(delta: float, target: Vector2) -> void:
+	var start := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	_nav_cd -= delta
+	var c := cell_at(free_point(target, 19.0))
+	if not _building and _nav_cd <= 0.0 and c != _target_cell:
+		_target_cell = c
+		_flow_target = cell_center(c)
+		_nav_cd = 0.2
+		_distance.fill(NO_PATH)
+		_next_flow.fill(Vector2.ZERO)
+		_distance[c] = 0
+		_queue[0] = c
+		_qread = 0
+		_qwrite = 1
+		_building = true
+	if _building:
+		var end := _qread + FLOW_BUDGET
+		while _qread < _qwrite and _qread < end:
+			var at := _queue[_qread]
+			_qread += 1
+			for direction_index in 4:
+				var next := _adjacency[at * 4 + direction_index]
+				if next < 0 or _distance[next] != NO_PATH:
+					continue
+				_distance[next] = _distance[at] + 1
+				_next_flow[next] = _directions[direction_index]
+				_queue[_qwrite] = next
+				_qwrite += 1
+		if _qread == _qwrite:
+			_building = false
+			_flow_ready = true
+			_los_version += 1
+			nav_completed += 1
+			var previous := flow
+			flow = _next_flow
+			_next_flow = previous
+	nav_worst_usec = maxi(nav_worst_usec, Time.get_ticks_usec() - start)
+
+
+func connected() -> bool:
+	return unreachable_cell() == -1
+
+
+func unreachable_cell() -> int:
+	# Независимый flood-fill для проверки профиля, без изменения активного поля.
+	var seen := PackedByteArray()
+	seen.resize(blocked.size())
+	var todo := PackedInt32Array([cell_at(arena.get_center())])
+	seen[todo[0]] = 1
+	var head := 0
+	while head < todo.size():
+		var c := todo[head]
+		head += 1
+		for offset: int in [-1, 1, -grid_w, grid_w]:
+			var next := c + offset
+			if next < 0 or next >= blocked.size() or (offset == -1 and c % grid_w == 0) or (offset == 1 and c % grid_w == grid_w - 1):
+				continue
+			if blocked[next] == 0 and seen[next] == 0:
+				seen[next] = 1
+				todo.append(next)
+	for c in blocked.size():
+		if blocked[c] == 0 and seen[c] == 0:
+			return c
+	return -1
+
+
+func damage(i: int, amount: float, fire := false) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= count or kind[i] > Kind.ACID or state[i] >= State.BURNING:
+		return
+	hp[i] -= amount
+	if hp[i] <= 60.0:
+		if state[i] == State.INTACT and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			_smoking.append(i)
+		state[i] = State.DAMAGED
+	if hp[i] <= 0.0 or (fire and kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK):
+		if kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK:
+			var smoking_index := _smoking.find(i)
+			if smoking_index >= 0:
+				_smoking.remove_at(smoking_index)
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			burn[i] = 4.0 + float(i % 3)
+			_burning.append(i)
+		else:
+			state[i] = State.BURNING
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func blast(at: Vector2, radius: float, amount: float) -> void:
+	for i in count:
+		if state[i] == State.GONE:
+			continue
+		var d2 := pos[i].distance_squared_to(at)
+		if d2 > (radius + half[i].x) * (radius + half[i].x):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES:
+			var away := (pos[i] - at).normalized()
+			pos[i] += away * 12.0
+			rotation_angle[i] += 0.7
+		elif kind[i] <= Kind.ACID:
+			damage(i, amount * (1.0 - 0.5 * minf(sqrt(d2) / radius, 1.0)), amount >= 100.0)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func charge(at: Vector2, radius: float) -> bool:
+	var stopped := false
+	var dirty := false
+	var link := near_head[cell_at(at)]
+	while link != -1:
+		var i := _link_obj[link]
+		link = _link_next[link]
+		if state[i] == State.GONE or not _overlaps(i, at, radius):
+			continue
+		if kind[i] == Kind.BAGS or kind[i] == Kind.WOOD:
+			state[i] = State.GONE
+			dirty = true
+		else:
+			damage(i, 180.0, true)
+			stopped = true
+	if dirty:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	return stopped
+
+
+## Кровь выбирает заранее обрезанную по альфе ступень того же атласа.
+func splatter(at: Vector2, _dir := Vector2.ZERO, _death := 0, _facing := 0.0, _variant := 0) -> void:
+	var changed := false
+	for i in count:
+		if kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES or state[i] == State.GONE or blood[i] >= 3:
+			continue
+		if _overlaps(i, at, 42.0):
+			blood[i] += 1
+			blood_events += 1
+			changed = true
+	if changed:
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if player:
+		navigation_step(delta, player.global_position)
+	_fire_tick -= delta
+	var fire_tick := _fire_tick <= 0.0
+	if fire_tick:
+		_fire_tick = 0.25
+	for n in range(_burning.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var i := _burning[n]
+		burn[i] -= delta
+		if burn[i] <= 0.0:
+			_blast_queue.append(i)
+			_burning.remove_at(n)
+		elif fire_tick and horde:
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], half[i].x + 18.0):
+				if _overlaps(i, horde.pos[j], 18.0):
+					horde.ignite(j, 6.0, 2.0)
+	# Снимок FIFO: цепь не рекурсивна, максимум четыре детонации за тик.
+	var n := mini(4, _blast_queue.size())
+	for j in n:
+		var i := _blast_queue[0]
+		_blast_queue.remove_at(0)
+		_detonate(i)
+
+
+func _detonate(i: int) -> void:
+	var car := kind[i] <= Kind.TRUCK
+	state[i] = State.WRECK if car else State.GONE
+	detonations += 1
+	if kind[i] == Kind.ACID:
+		if hazards:
+			hazards.acid_pool(pos[i], 32.0, 8.0, 6.0)
+	else:
+		var radius := CAR_RADIUS if car else BARREL_RADIUS
+		var amount := CAR_DAMAGE if car else BARREL_DAMAGE
+		if explosions:
+			explosions.spawn(pos[i], radius, Explosions.Kind.CAR if car else Explosions.Kind.GRENADE)
+		if sfx:
+			sfx.play("explosions/grenade", pos[i], -1.0, 0.02)
+		if horde:
+			var previous := horde.death_override
+			horde.death_override = Gore.Death.GIBS
+			for j in horde.query_radius(pos[i], radius):
+				var offset := horde.pos[j] - pos[i]
+				var falloff := 1.0 - 0.5 * minf(offset.length() / radius, 1.0)
+				horde.damage(j, amount * falloff, offset.normalized(), 210.0, WeaponDefs.Ammo.STANDARD, false, horde.pos[j], true)
+			horde.death_override = previous
+		if player and player.global_position.distance_squared_to(pos[i]) < radius * radius:
+			player.take_damage(amount)
+		blast(pos[i], radius, amount * 3.0)
+		splatter(pos[i])
+	if not car:
+		rebuild_grid()
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_visual_tick += delta
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self)
+	var cell := Vector2i(view.position / 48.0)
+	if cell != _view_cell or ((not _burning.is_empty() or not _smoking.is_empty()) and _visual_tick >= 0.083):
+		_view_cell = cell
+		_visual_tick = 0.0
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _tile(i: int) -> int:
+	var k := kind[i]
+	if k <= Kind.TRUCK:
+		return k * 4 + mini(state[i], 3)
+	if k <= Kind.ACID:
+		return 20 + (k - Kind.RED) * 2 + (1 if state[i] == State.DAMAGED else 0)
+	return 24 + k - Kind.JERSEY
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if _atlas == null:
+		return
+	var view := PixelArt.view_rect(self, 130.0)
+	# Мусор в том же пакете, перед высокими объектами.
+	for layer in 2:
+		for i in count:
+			if state[i] == State.GONE or not view.has_point(pos[i]) or (kind[i] >= Kind.TIRES) != (layer == 0):
+				continue
+			var tile := _tile(i) + int(blood[i]) * TILES
+			var source := Rect2(Vector2(tile % 8, tile / 8) * ART_CELL, ART_CELL)
+			draw_set_transform(pos[i], rotation_angle[i], Vector2.ONE * PixelArt.ART_SCALE)
+			draw_texture_rect_region(_atlas, Rect2(-ART_CELL * 0.5, ART_CELL), source)
+	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
+	for i in _smoking:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 180 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 20.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-14, -30), Vector2(28, 32)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.55, 0.52, 0.45))
+	for i in _burning:
+		if not view.has_point(pos[i]):
+			continue
+		var frame := int(Time.get_ticks_msec() / 80 + i) % 8
+		var at := pos[i] + axis[i] * 18.0
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_smoke, Rect2(at + Vector2(-24, -50), Vector2(48, 52)), Rect2(frame * 96, 0, 96, 96), Color(0.55, 0.54, 0.51, 0.65))
+		draw_texture_rect_region(_fire, Rect2(at - Vector2(16, 30), Vector2(32, 36)), Rect2((frame + 2) * 144, (i % 3) * 144, 144, 144))

## Ближайший образец (для автопилота симуляции) или Vector2.INF.
func nearest(p: Vector2, max_dist: float) -> Vector2:
	var best := Vector2.INF
	var best_d := max_dist * max_dist
	for i in count:
		var d := _pos[i].distance_squared_to(p)
		if d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = _pos[i]
	return best


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	_time += delta
	if player == null:
		return
	var pp := player.global_position
	var r2 := radius * radius
	var i := count - 1
	while i >= 0:
		var p := _pos[i]
		var to := pp - p
		var d2 := to.length_squared()
		if _pulled[i] == 0 and d2 < r2 and not player.is_dead:
			_pulled[i] = 1
		if _pulled[i] == 1:
			var dist := sqrt(d2)
			if dist < COLLECT_DIST:
				collected_total += _val[i]
				collected.emit(_val[i])
				_remove(i)
				i -= 1
				continue
			_vel[i] = _vel[i].move_toward(to / maxf(dist, 0.01) * PULL_SPEED, 900.0 * delta)
		else:
			_vel[i] = _vel[i] * exp(-6.0 * delta)
		_pos[i] = p + _vel[i] * delta
		i -= 1
	queue_redraw()


func _remove(i: int) -> void:
	count -= 1
	_pos[i] = _pos[count]
	_vel[i] = _vel[count]
	_val[i] = _val[count]
	_pulled[i] = _pulled[count]
	_phase[i] = _phase[count]
	_pos.resize(count)
	_vel.resize(count)
	_val.resize(count)
	_pulled.resize(count)
	_phase.resize(count)

+"""Один контролируемый запуск. Оконные и perf-прогоны всегда берут общий lock."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+GODOT = 'C:/Users/Dev/Desktop/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe'
+LOCK = 'C:/Users/Dev/Desktop/zera-assets/locks/godot_exclusive.sh'
+label, mode, *args = sys.argv[1:]
+logs = ROOT / 'design/tasks/reports'
+env = os.environ.copy()
+env['APPDATA'] = str(logs / 'o1_runtime')
+env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
+(logs / 'o1_runtime').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+original = {}
+if '--pre-e1b' in args:
+    args.remove('--pre-e1b')
+    for file in ('game.gd', 'weapons.gd', 'hazards.gd'):
+        path = ROOT / 'scripts' / file
+        original[path] = path.read_bytes()
+        source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:scripts/' + file], cwd=ROOT)
+        if file == 'game.gd':
+            source = source.replace(b'func _ready() -> void:\n', b'func _ready() -> void:\n\tseed(81073)\n', 1)
+        path.write_bytes(source)
+command = [GODOT]
+if mode == 'headless' or mode == 'import':
+    command += ['--headless']
+else:
+    command += ['--disable-vsync']
+command += ['--path', str(ROOT), '--log-file', str(logs / ('o1_' + label + '_engine.log'))]
+if mode == 'import':
+    command += ['--import']
+else:
+    command += ['--', *args]
+if mode == 'window':
+    command = ['C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/bash.exe', LOCK, *command]
+print('RUN', label, ' '.join(command), flush=True)
+start = time.monotonic()
+try:
+    with (logs / ('o1_' + label + '.log')).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as log:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        try:
+            code = process.wait(timeout=850 if mode == 'window' else 300)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/PID', str(process.pid), '/T', '/F'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
+            code = 124
+    print('EXIT', label, code, 'seconds=%.2f' % (time.monotonic()-start), flush=True)
+    lines = (logs / ('o1_' + label + '.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines()
+    interesting = [line for line in lines if any(t in line for t in ('GODOT_EXCLUSIVE', 'BENCH', 'OBSTEST', 'SIM ', 'TEST ', 'TEST ok', 'FXTEST', 'BOSS ', 'ALARM ', 'ERROR:', 'WARNING:'))]
+    print('\n'.join(interesting[-60:]), flush=True)
+finally:
+    for path, source in original.items():
+        path.write_bytes(source)
+sys.exit(code)

+class_name ArenaLayout
+extends RefCounted
+## Профиль — данные для O2; локальный RNG не меняет случайность боя.
+
+const QUARANTINE := {"name": "quarantine", "size": Vector2(2560, 1440),
+	"cars": 32, "barrels": 20, "checkpoints": 10, "litter": 320,
+	"vehicles": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], "roads": [0.5, 0.5], "safe_radius": 200.0}
+
+
+static func generate(layout_seed: int, profile: Dictionary) -> Array[Dictionary]:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = layout_seed
+	var size: Vector2 = profile.get("size", Vector2(2560, 1440))
+	var center := size * 0.5
+	var safe: float = profile.get("safe_radius", 200.0)
+	var roads: Array = profile.get("roads", [0.5, 0.5])
+	var vehicles: Array = profile.get("vehicles", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	var occupied := PackedVector2Array()
+	# Машины в двух полосах двух дорог; отдельные развёрнуты после аварии.
+	for i in int(profile.get("cars", 32)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var horizontal := i % 2 == 0
+			var lane := -65.0 if i % 4 < 2 else 65.0
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(120, size.x - 120), size.y * float(roads[1]) + lane)
+			if not horizontal:
+				p = Vector2(size.x * float(roads[0]) + lane, rng.randf_range(110, size.y - 110))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe, 104.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := (0.0 if horizontal else PI * 0.5) + rng.randf_range(-0.17, 0.17)
+			if i % 9 == 0:
+				angle += 0.5
+			result.append({"kind": int(vehicles[i % vehicles.size()]), "pos": p, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	# Открытые блокпосты: линии не соединяются в замкнутый периметр.
+	for i in int(profile.get("checkpoints", 10)):
+		for attempt in 200:
+			var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(100, size.x - 100), rng.randf_range(100, size.y - 100))
+			if not _available(p, occupied, center, safe + 45.0, 120.0):
+				continue
+			var angle := float(i % 2) * PI * 0.5
+			for j in 3:
+				var at := p + Vector2(float(j - 1) * 49.0, 0).rotated(angle)
+				result.append({"kind": 7 if j < 2 else (8 if i % 2 == 0 else 10), "pos": at, "angle": angle})
+			occupied.append(p)
+			break
+	for i in int(profile.get("barrels", 20)):
+		var at: Vector2 = result[i % mini(32, result.size())]["pos"]
+		var p := at + Vector2(0, 51.0 if i % 2 == 0 else -51.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 5 if i % 3 != 0 else 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	for i in 12:
+		var p := Vector2(170.0 + float(i % 6) * 430.0, 60.0 if i < 6 else size.y - 60.0)
+		result.append({"kind": 9, "pos": p, "angle": 0.0})
+	for i in int(profile.get("litter", 320)):
+		var p := Vector2(rng.randf_range(30, size.x - 30), rng.randf_range(30, size.y - 30))
+		result.append({"kind": 11 + i % 6, "pos": p, "angle": rng.randf() * TAU})
+	# Проверяем именно сетку с запасом элитки, которую затем использует орда.
+	var probe := Obstacles.new()
+	for attempt in 40:
+		probe.setup(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), result)
+		var unreachable := probe.unreachable_cell()
+		if unreachable == -1:
+			break
+		var at := probe.cell_center(unreachable)
+		var nearest := -1
+		var distance := INF
+		for i in result.size():
+			if int(result[i]["kind"]) >= 11:
+				continue
+			var d := Vector2(result[i]["pos"]).distance_squared_to(at)
+			if d < distance:
+				nearest = i
+				distance = d
+		if nearest < 0:
+			break
+		var p := Vector2(result[nearest]["pos"]) + Vector2(90, 75).rotated(float(attempt) * 2.4)
+		p = p.clamp(Vector2(95, 95), size - Vector2(95, 95))
+		if p.distance_to(center) < safe + 55.0:
+			p = center + (p - center).normalized() * (safe + 90.0)
+		result[nearest]["pos"] = p
+	probe.free()
+	return result
+
+
+static func _available(p: Vector2, occupied: PackedVector2Array, center: Vector2, safe: float, gap: float) -> bool:
+	if p.distance_squared_to(center) < (safe + 55.0) * (safe + 55.0):
+		return false
+	for q in occupied:
+		if p.distance_squared_to(q) < gap * gap:
+			return false
+	return true

+func scorch(tex: Texture2D, pos: Vector2, rot: float, scale_factor: float) -> void:
+	var stamp_data := [tex, pos, rot, scale_factor * PixelArt.ART_SCALE]

+			_scorch_layer.draw_texture(tex, -tex.get_size() * 0.5)
+	_scorch_layer.draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)
